articles.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Policy-shift distillation reuses the difference between a teacher's log probabilities before and after reinforcement learning (RL) as supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, this endpoint policy shift cannot reveal whether local action preferences evolved consistently during teacher training. The same endpoint shift can result from early and late shifts that reinforce or partially cancel each other. We investigate whether agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts can guide selective transfer. We introduce Waypoint-guided On-Policy Distillation (Waypoint-OPD), which uses an intermediate teacher checkpoint from the same RL run to compare early and late shifts in relative action preferences at student-visited prefixes. We gate the endpoint shift according to the directional agreement between the early and late shifts, suppressing it when they point in opposing directions. Compared with endpoint-only transfer, our method requires only one additional frozen-teacher scoring pass. Using RL-trained Qwen3-4B teachers, we evaluate our method with Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Qwen3-30B-A3B as student models in mathematical and code reasoning. In all six domain--student settings, Waypoint-OPD achieves the highest domain-average score among the compared distillation methods. Ablations with the Qwen3-8B student show that removing or shuffling gates reduces mathematical reasoning performance. These results support the use of directional agreement between early and late teacher policy shifts to weight the endpoint shift during student training.
articles.titleCn: Waypoint-OPD：通过门控在线策略蒸馏转移RL诱导的策略变化
articles.abstractCn: 策略转移蒸馏重用了教师模型在强化学习（RL）前后日志概率的差异，将其作为学生生成轨迹的监督信息。然而，这种终点策略转移无法揭示教师训练过程中局部动作偏好的演变是否一致。相同的终点转移可能由早期和晚期转移共同作用或部分抵消产生。我们研究了早期和晚期教师策略转移之间的一致性是否能够指导选择性迁移。我们引入了航点引导的在线策略蒸馏（Waypoint-OPD），该技术使用同一RL运行中的中间教师检查点，比较学生在访问的前缀中早期和晚期转移的相对动作偏好。我们根据早期和晚期转移的方向性一致情况对终点转移进行门控，当它们指向相反方向时抑制其影响。与仅使用终点转移相比，我们的方法仅需一次额外的冻结教师评分通过。我们使用RL训练的Qwen3-4B教师模型，以Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B和Qwen3-30B-A3B作为学生模型，在数学和代码推理任务中评估我们的方法。在所有六个领域-学生设置中，Waypoint-OPD在比较的蒸馏方法中实现了最高的领域平均得分。使用Qwen3-8B学生模型的消融实验表明，移除或打乱门控会降低数学推理性能。这些结果支持在学生训练过程中使用早期和晚期教师策略转移之间的方向性一致来加权终点转移。

articles.title: Rethinking the Role of Tool Graph Memory in Multi-Turn Tool Use
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks by calling external tools over multiple turns. Recent work has proposed tool graph memory, which stores past experience as tool transitions to guide subsequent selection. However, it remains unclear whether this component consistently improves agents' tool use or undermines it. We evaluate tool graph memory on nine models and two benchmarks, finding that it seldom improves significantly over baselines, and that its gains, where present, cost over twice the LLM calls. The memory's guidance is often incorrect, and random or no guidance retains most of the gain, implying that the benefit stems from extra computation rather than the memory itself. Moreover, even with the correct next tool suggested, many failures remain, such as giving up without a tool call. Storing the same experience instead as textual insights outperforms tool graph memory with almost no extra LLM calls. This suggests that memory serves better as a soft prior than as a prescription of the next tool, leading to a more effective and generalizable solution.
articles.titleCn: 重新思考多轮工具使用中工具图记忆的作用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过多轮调用外部工具来解决复杂任务。近期研究提出了工具图记忆，将过去的经验存储为工具转换来指导后续选择。然而，该组件是否始终提升代理的工具使用效果，或反而削弱其效果，目前尚不明确。我们在九个模型和两个基准上评估了工具图记忆，发现它很少显著优于基线，且其收益（当存在时）需要超过两倍的LLM调用成本。该记忆的指导往往不准确，随机或无指导仍能保留大部分收益，这表明其优势源于额外计算而非记忆本身。此外，即使正确推荐了下一个工具，仍存在许多失败情况，例如放弃不进行工具调用。将相同经验以文本洞察的形式存储，几乎无需额外LLM调用，其效果优于工具图记忆。这表明记忆更适合作为软先验，而非下一个工具的指令，从而导向更有效且更具泛化性的解决方案。

articles.title: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed as conversational agents are increasingly expected to follow procedural logic. While factual hallucination has received extensive attention, a different failure mode has been overlooked: procedural hallucination, in which an agent produces individually fluent and factually plausible utterances while deviating from the intended conversational process. We introduce DialFork, the first benchmark to measure this failure mode on raw dialogue text. DialFork is built by forking conformant dialogues at controlled turn positions and injecting one of four hallucination types, yielding 36,278 dialogues across 24 tasks in 12 domains; 30 human annotators validate the construction. We define three evaluation tasks that characterize procedural deviation at three granularities: how far a set of dialogues deviates from conformant ones (monitoring deployed agents), how far a single dialogue does (procedural retrieval), and at which turn a dialogue first goes off-track (real-time guardrails). For the first two, we propose dialog-flow-aware metrics, FlowKL and FlowScore, that compare dialogues by how they unfold rather than their content. At the dialogue level, FlowScore significantly outperforms all baselines across seven encoders, showing that semantic similarity is no substitute for procedural similarity. We release DialFork under the MIT license at https://github.com/idiap/dialfork, hoping the community will measure conversational process alongside content.
articles.titleCn: DialFork：超越事实性以评估对话代理中的程序性幻觉
articles.abstractCn: 作为对话代理部署的大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越被期望遵循程序逻辑。虽然事实性幻觉已受到广泛关注，但存在一种被忽视的失效模式：程序性幻觉，即代理产生单个流畅且事实合理的陈述，但偏离了预期的对话流程。我们介绍了DialFork，首个用于在原始对话文本上衡量这种失效模式的基准。DialFork通过在受控的回合位置分支符合规范的对话，并注入四种幻觉类型之一构建而成，共生成12个领域24项任务中的36,278个对话；30名人类标注者验证了其构建过程。我们定义了三个评估任务，以三种粒度刻画程序性偏离：一组对话偏离符合规范对话的程度（监控部署的代理）、单个对话偏离的程度（程序性检索）以及对话首次偏离的回合（实时护栏）。针对前两个任务，我们提出了对话流感知指标FlowKL和FlowScore，通过对话的展开方式而非内容进行比较。在对话层面，FlowScore在七种编码器上显著优于所有基线，表明语义相似性并不能替代程序相似性。我们已将DialFork以MIT许可证发布在https://github.com/idiap/dialfork，希望社区能在衡量内容的同时评估对话流程。

articles.title: Writability and the Pathway: A Controlled Study of Knowledge Injection into Addressed Memory
articles.abstract: Addressed conditional memory provides a local surface for post-hoc knowledge injection, but a successful write need not transfer to a new question or preserve untargeted behavior. This study combines a controlled GPT-2 comparison with production-memory experiments on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Newly initialized modules attached to frozen GPT-2 are tested in a 2 x 2 design: row-only versus row-plus-projection updates, each with or without fixed module-residual anchoring. All arms reproduce 50 trained completions in each of three sampling seeds. Natural-question target-string hits average 5.3% for both row-only arms, 28.7% for unanchored projection updates, and 22.0% with anchoring, while strict answer scores remain zero. Anchoring lowers measured drift; lexical hits do not establish entity-specific retrieval. In the archived Qwen experiments, gradient writes make the designated first answer token top-ranked for 132 independently reset targets, comprising 93 new promotions and 39 already top-ranked targets. A separate matched 24-target comparison gives 13 new promotions with Adam versus two with SPSA at equal iteration counts but unequal computational procedures. An 80-row case includes saved continuations and a replay record, while reformulations bound its scope. Six DeepSeek zero-order cases yield one new target-token promotion and one regression. These results support bounded writing feasibility and separate trained expression, question-form behavior, and preservation; first-token rankings do not establish complete-answer success or universal conditions for writable memory.
articles.titleCn: 可写性与路径：一项关于知识注入到指定内存的受控研究
articles.abstractCn: 条件性记忆为事后知识注入提供了局部表面，但成功的写入不必转移到新问题或保留非目标行为。本研究结合了受控的GPT-2对比实验与Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的生成记忆实验。新初始化的模块连接到冻结的GPT-2，在2 x 2设计中测试：仅行更新与行加投影更新，每种情况均有固定模块残差锚定或不锚定。所有分支均在每个三个采样种子中复现50个训练完成的实例。自然问题目标字符串命中率在仅行分支中平均为5.3%，非锚定投影更新为28.7%，锚定更新为22.0%，而严格答案分数仍为零。锚定降低了测量漂移；词汇命中未能建立特定实体检索。在存档的Qwen实验中，梯度写入使指定的第一个答案标记在132个独立重置的目标中位居前列，包括93个新晋升和39个已位居前列的目标。一个单独的匹配24目标对比实验显示，Adam在相同迭代次数但不同计算流程下产生13个新晋升，而SPSA产生2个。一个80行案例包括保存的延续和重放记录，而重述限制了其范围。六个DeepSeek零阶案例产生一个新目标标记晋升和一个回归。这些结果支持有限写入的可行性以及分别训练的表达、问题形成行为和保留；首个标记排名未能确立完整答案成功或可写记忆的普遍条件。

articles.title: SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics
articles.abstract: Understanding how the human brain constructs meaning from real-world language remains a fundamental challenge, as semantics depend on context that varies in natural settings. To enable the study of real-world linguistic meaning in the brain, we introduce SCRIBE, a framework grounded in a neuroscience-informed semantic space that leverages an ensemble of open-source large language models to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations of arbitrary text. In a behavioral study with 921 participants, we show that human semantic feature judgments vary systematically with context, and that SCRIBE captures these shifts, reaching 75-81% of the estimated human noise ceiling. Using brain activity recorded while participants listen to naturalistic stories, we further demonstrate that SCRIBE predicts neural responses in language-selective brain regions, significantly outperforming non-contextual semantic representations. Variance partitioning reveals that SCRIBE explains unique brain-predictive information beyond syntactic features, suggesting that its representations capture aspects of linguistic meaning not accounted for by the measured syntactic features. Together, these findings establish SCRIBE as a scalable and interpretable foundation for studying natural language semantics in the brain.
articles.titleCn: SCRIBE：可扩展的、基于可解释脑部语义的上下文表征
articles.abstractCn: 理解人类大脑如何从现实世界语言中构建意义仍然是一个基本挑战，因为语义依赖于在自然环境中变化的语境。为了使大脑中现实世界语言意义的研究成为可能，我们引入了SCRIBE，这是一个基于神经科学指导的语义空间的框架，该框架利用一组开源大型语言模型来生成任意文本的可解释、词级的语义表征。在一项涉及921名参与者的行为研究中，我们表明人类的语义特征判断系统地随着语境变化，而SCRIBE捕捉了这些变化，达到了估计的人类噪声上限的75-81%。通过记录参与者聆听自然故事时的脑活动，我们进一步证明SCRIBE预测了语言选择脑区的神经反应，显著优于非语境语义表征。方差分解揭示，SCRIBE解释了超出句法特征的独特脑预测信息，表明其表征捕捉了被测句法特征所未能涵盖的语言意义方面。综合这些发现，将SCRIBE确立为研究大脑中自然语言语义的可扩展和可解释基础。

articles.title: Decomposing Brain-LLM Alignment with Interpretable Semantic Representations
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) predict neural responses during naturalistic language comprehension, but the linguistic information underlying this brain alignment remains difficult to interpret. We use SCRIBE, an interpretable contextual semantic representation spanning 65 neurocognitively grounded semantic properties, as a lens for decomposing the brain alignment of one LLM, LLaMA2-7B. Using variance partitioning between LLaMA2-7B and SCRIBE on naturalistic fMRI data from seven participants listening to narrative stories (Moth Radio Hour), we separate brain-predictive variance shared between the two representations from variance unique to each. We find that shared variance is the dominant component across the whole brain and language-related regions, while both representations also retain significant unique contributions. We then examine whether the concreteness of individual semantic properties relates to shared and SCRIBE-unique brain-predictive variance. Concrete properties show greater shared variance with LLaMA2-7B than abstract properties across the whole brain and most examined regions, whereas abstract properties do not show greater SCRIBE-unique variance. Finally, property ablations reveal that semantic contributions extend across multiple dimensions, with cumulative effects on both shared and SCRIBE-unique variance. Together, these results show that, for LLaMA2-7B on this dataset, a substantial portion of brain-LLM alignment is associated with interpretable semantic information, while revealing complementary brain-predictive semantic information beyond the LLaMA2-7B representation.
articles.titleCn: 使用可解释的语义表示分解脑-LLM对齐
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言理解过程中预测神经反应，但支撑这种大脑一致性背后的语言信息仍然难以解释。我们使用SCRIBE，一种涵盖65种神经认知基础语义属性的、可解释的上下文语义表示，作为透镜来分解一个LLM（LLaMA2-7B）的大脑一致性。通过在七名参与者聆听叙事故事（Moth Radio Hour）的自然fMRI数据上对LLaMA2-7B和SCRIBE进行方差分解，我们将两种表示之间共享的大脑预测方差与各自独特的方差分离开来。我们发现，共享方差在整个大脑和语言相关区域是主导成分，而两种表示也保留了显著的独特贡献。接着，我们考察单个语义属性的具象性与共享方差和SCRIBE独特的方差之间的关系。具象属性在全脑和大多数考察区域与LLaMA2-7B的共享方差大于抽象属性，而抽象属性并未显示出更大的SCRIBE独特方差。最后，属性消融实验表明，语义贡献跨越多个维度，对共享方差和SCRIBE独特方差均产生累积效应。综合这些结果，表明对于LLaMA2-7B在这个数据集上，大脑-LLM一致性的大部分与可解释的语义信息相关，同时揭示了超越LLaMA2-7B表示的互补的大脑预测语义信息。

articles.title: OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
articles.abstract: Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on reminder-free student rollouts. Successful rollouts provide autoregressive self-imitation targets, whereas failed rollouts receive Reminder-conditioned reverse-KL supervision from a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes. A Global Reminder converts final-test diagnostics into trajectory-level guidance, while Turn-local Reminders apply only to the next decision following the relevant environment observation. The teacher and student share a two-stage initialization from Coding SFT and Instruction-Following (IF) SFT. At inference, the student operates without Reminders. On SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, and SWE-bench Multilingual, OPRD improves the benchmark-averaged task resolution rate by 11.3 points over the open-source Qwen3.5-4B base model. Under the same diagnostic protocol, it reduces the aggregate error-event count from 446 to 222, a 50.2% reduction.
articles.titleCn: OPRD：用于长时程编码代理的在线策略提醒蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 可靠的代码库级编码要求代理不仅能够生成正确代码，还要在长时间交互中保持约束并响应工具反馈。然而，我们的诊断分析表明，代理往往未能利用上下文中已有的相关信息，而最终的通过/失败结果仅提供了稀疏的过程监督。我们引入了策略内提醒蒸馏（OPRD），它结合了多范围提醒监督和无提醒学生展开的基于结果的路由。成功的展开提供了自回归自我模仿目标，而失败的展开则从教师那里接收提醒条件下的反向KL监督，教师重新评估相同的学生生成的代码前缀。全局提醒将最终测试诊断转化为轨迹级指导，而回合本地提醒仅适用于在相关环境观察后的下一个决策。教师和学生共享从代码SFT和指令跟随（IF）SFT的两阶段初始化。在推理时，学生不使用提醒。在SWE-bench验证版、SWE-bench专业版和SWE-bench多语言版上，OPRD比开源的Qwen3.5-4B基础模型提高了基准平均任务解决率11.3个百分点。在相同的诊断协议下，它将总错误事件数从446减少到222，降低了50.2%。

articles.title: Can LLMs Tell Stories Out of Order? A Corpus and Benchmark for Nonlinear Narrative Generation
articles.abstract: Every story has two orders: the order in which its events happen and the order in which they are told. A story is nonlinear when the two differ. We introduce a benchmark of 83 published works that measures whether language models can tell nonlinear stories. For each work, we annotate one list of events in both orders, together with a story graph of causal dependencies, character knowledge, and the questions the telling raises and resolves. Given events in chronological order, all 19 models tell them, on average, more chronologically than the published works do; asked for a specific structure, they land within the human range about half the time. We then compare a model's stories of the same events under different conditions, using both an automated judge and 71 human readers. Both prefer the chronological story a model writes by default to the nonlinear one it writes on request, which readers find harder to follow in 81% of decisive judgments. Readers also prefer stories written from the story graph to stories constrained to the published telling order (72% of decisive judgments), a difference the judge does not detect. Our results suggest that following an instruction to reorder a story is not yet the same as telling it well out of order.
articles.comment: Under review, 36 pages, 13 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/LLM-nonlinear-storytelling. Project page: https://nonlinear-narrative.github.io
articles.titleCn: LLMs能否讲述非线性故事？非线性叙事生成的语料库与基准
articles.abstractCn: 每个故事都有两种顺序：事件发生的顺序和讲述的顺序。当这两种顺序不同时，故事就是非线性的。我们引入了一个包含83部已发表作品的基准，用于衡量语言模型是否能够讲述非线性故事。对于每部作品，我们标注了两种顺序的事件列表，并构建了故事图，其中包含因果依赖关系、人物知识和讲述中提出并解决的问题。在按时间顺序给出的事件中，所有19个模型平均而言比已发表作品更按时间顺序讲述；当要求特定结构时，它们大约一半的时间能够达到人类水平。然后，我们使用自动评判器和71位人类读者，比较模型在不同条件下对同一事件的讲述。两者都更倾向于模型默认按时间顺序讲述的故事，而非请求下编写的非线性故事，人类读者在81%的关键判断中认为后者更难理解。读者也更倾向于从故事图中编写的故事，而非受限于已发表讲述顺序的故事（72%的关键判断），而评判器并未发现这种差异。我们的结果表明，遵循指令重新排序故事与出色地讲述非线性故事尚有不同。

articles.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would modify the environment. The strong model then verifies the drafted segment in a single prefill pass, commits the longest prefix it judges semantically valid, and repairs the first rejected step. Because verification replaces autoregressive decoding with parallel prefill, the strong model decodes only short verdicts and occasional repairs rather than every step. On $τ^2$-Bench, SpecAgent comes within one point of the strong model's success rate while roughly halving memory traffic and wall time, and on AutomationBench and VitaBench it recovers 44-75% of the quality gap while lowering both. In an edge-cloud deployment on MCP-Atlas with three cloud models, it closes 53-75% of the weak-strong quality gap while the strong model generates at most half as many tokens. These results suggest that a strong model need not author every step of an agent: reviewing grounded drafts retains most of its quality while cutting both latency and memory traffic.
articles.titleCn: 基于语义验证的工具使用代理的轨迹级推测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型代理通过一系列工具调用解决任务，而当前的主流设计是单一强大的模型生成每一步，尽管许多步骤都足够简单，可以用一个更小的模型来完成。现有的分工方式仍将强大的模型作为生成者：路由器和协作代理决定哪个模型处理每个查询或步骤，而推测方法则逐个检查小模型的草稿，通常与强大模型自己的行动进行对比。我们引入了SpecAgent，这是一种协作协议，将强大的模型从每一步的作者转变为对小模型草稿的审阅者。小模型在草稿过程中执行只读工具调用，这样每一步都基于真实观察，并包含第一个可能改变环境的行动。然后强大的模型通过一次预填充遍历来验证草稿片段，提交其判断为语义上有效的最长前缀，并修复第一个被拒绝的步骤。由于验证用并行预填充替代了自回归解码，强大的模型只需解码短评语和偶尔的修复，而不是每一步。在$τ^2$-Bench上，SpecAgent的成功率仅比强大模型低一分，同时将内存流量和墙时大致减半；在AutomationBench和VitaBench上，它弥补了44-75%的质量差距，同时降低了差距。在MCP-Atlas上的边缘云部署中，使用三个云模型，它缩小了53-75%的弱强质量差距，而强大模型生成的token数量最多只有一半。这些结果表明，强大的模型不必为代理的每一步负责：审阅基于真实观察的草稿可以保留其大部分质量，同时减少延迟和内存流量。

articles.title: Translation Circuit Discovery and Targeted Optimization for Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
articles.abstract: Recent multilingual large language models achieve strong translation performance, yet the internal mechanisms responsible for low-resource multilingual translation remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we study translation circuits in multilingual decoder-only LLMs for Hindi-to-Urdu and Hindi-to-Sindhi (Devanagari). We propose TITAN, a mechanistic framework that combines causal intervention, sparse feature decomposition, and targeted preference optimization to identify and optimize crucial translation components in the transformer. Unlike conventional full-parameter fine-tuning, TITAN restricts optimization to sparse, causally important circuits, enabling scalable and parameter-efficient adaptation while updating fewer than 5% of model parameters. Experimental results show that TITAN achieves BLEU improvements of 33.75% on Hindi-to-Urdu and 45.86% on Hindi-to-Sindhi over the strongest multilingual baselines. Human expert evaluation further confirms substantial gains in adequacy and fluency across both language pairs. Additional analyses reveal that multilingual translation is implemented through sparse, structured circuits operating over a shared semantic subspace rather than through an English-centric pivot representation. Overall, our findings demonstrate that mechanistic circuit discovery can directly improve low-resource multilingual translation while providing interpretable insights into multilingual transformer behavior.
articles.titleCn: 低资源多语言翻译的翻译电路发现与靶向优化
articles.abstractCn: 近期多语言大型语言模型在翻译方面取得了优异的性能，然而负责低资源多语言翻译的内部机制仍缺乏充分理解。本文研究了多语言解码器仅大型语言模型中印地语到乌尔都语和印地语到信德语（天城文）的翻译电路。我们提出了TITAN，一个结合因果干预、稀疏特征分解和目标偏好优化的机制化框架，用于识别和优化Transformer中的关键翻译组件。与传统的全参数微调不同，TITAN将优化限制在稀疏且因果重要的电路中，从而实现可扩展且参数高效的适配，同时更新模型参数不到5%。实验结果表明，TITAN在印地语到乌尔都语和印地语到信德语任务上，相较于最强的多语言基线模型分别提升了33.75%和45.86%的BLEU分数。人类专家评估进一步证实了在这两种语言对中翻译的充分性和流畅性均有显著提升。额外分析揭示，多语言翻译是通过在共享语义子空间上运行的稀疏、结构化电路实现的，而非通过以英语为中心的枢轴表示。总体而言，我们的研究证明机制化电路发现可以直接提升低资源多语言翻译，同时为多语言Transformer的行为提供可解释的洞察。

articles.title: SITAR: A Situational Distortion Metric for Automatic Speech Recognition Evaluation
articles.abstract: In automatic speech recognition (ASR), transcription errors with similar lexical or semantic discrepancies can have markedly different consequences for the situation conveyed by speech. Capturing these differences requires not merely contextual assessment, but an understanding of what the spoken discourse describes, establishes, or seeks to bring about. However, relying on LLM judges introduces computational cost and scoring variability. We introduce SITAR, a situational distortion metric for ASR, realized through a comprehensive end-to-end construction framework. Specifically, this framework aggregates situational severity and cumulative extent into a unified score via a bounded recursive formulation. Using targets derived from this formulation with limited offline LLM support, we train SITAR as a lightweight BERT-family regressor that scores reference-hypothesis pairs in a single forward pass, entirely free of any prohibitive runtime costs. Recognizing that introducing a new metric demands rigorous justification, we formalize a principled validation protocol spanning both extrinsic validity, assessed at macro and micro levels, and intrinsic scorer reliability. The former, evaluated across diverse datasets and models, demonstrates that SITAR reliably tracks broad capability scaling while providing orthogonal diagnostic utility, whereas the latter, examined on a purpose-built controlled benchmark, confirms the operational soundness of the scoring instrument itself. Through systematic validation, we demonstrate that SITAR holds strong potential as a practical, lightweight complement to existing ASR metrics. We will release the full recipes (code, model weights, dataset, etc.) after the internal review to support community research.
articles.titleCn: SITAR：一种用于自动语音识别评估的情境失真度量
articles.abstractCn: 在自动语音识别（ASR）中，具有相似词汇或语义差异的转录错误会对语音所传达的情况产生显著不同的后果。捕捉这些差异不仅需要上下文评估，还需要理解口语论述所描述、建立或试图实现的内容。然而，依赖大型语言模型（LLM）的评判会引入计算成本和评分变异性。我们引入了SITAR，一种用于ASR的情境扭曲度量，它通过一个全面的端到端构建框架实现。具体而言，该框架通过有界的递归公式将情境严重性和累积范围聚合为一个统一分数。使用该公式推导出的目标，并借助有限的离线LLM支持，我们训练SITAR作为一个轻量级的BERT家族回归器，该回归器在单次前向传递中对参考-假设对进行评分，完全不受任何限制性的运行时成本。认识到引入新度量需要严格的论证，我们正式化了一个原则性的验证协议，涵盖外部的有效性（在宏观和微观层面进行评估）和内在评分器的可靠性。前者跨多种数据集和模型进行评估，表明SITAR可靠地跟踪了广泛的能力扩展，同时提供了正交的诊断效用；而后者在专门构建的受控基准上进行检验，证实了评分工具本身的操作稳健性。通过系统验证，我们证明了SITAR作为现有ASR度量的实用、轻量级补充具有巨大潜力。在内部评审后，我们将发布完整的配方（代码、模型权重、数据集等）以支持社区研究。

articles.title: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three Spec-Bench runs per system show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

articles.titleCn: HyCo：基于混合草图的移动-云推测解码成本效益方案
articles.abstractCn: 设备云推测解码减少了服务器的计算量，但使用小型语言模型（SLM）生成深度草稿树需要在移动神经处理单元（NPU）上进行多次遍历。我们提出了HyCo，它将深度分配给在设备上执行的服务器模型的本地多标记预测（MTP）头，并将替代分支分配给一次SLM遍历。服务器返回头所需隐藏状态、输入嵌入和键值条目，而不是执行其顺序步骤。量化、受限词汇和1K标记窗口使两个草稿者都适配NPU。ε阈值规则还放宽了对验证器采样分布的精确保留。在Galaxy S26 Ultra通过LTE/5G的单客户端运行中，与服务器端MTP自我推测相比，HyCo在Spec-Bench上每输出标记的服务器GPU时间减少了38.6%，在32K标记摘要上减少了29.2%。使用相同的接受规则，每个系统运行三次Spec-Bench显示，与仅SLM草稿者相比，节省了9.0个百分点，交付速度提高了1.9倍。HyCo与Cloud+MTP相比，法官评分提高了+0.2分（配对95% CI：-0.9到+1.3）；探索性翻译倾向于SpecEdge-ε。在不放宽的情况下，HyCo在两个数据集上精确节省了27.7%和11.9%。

articles.title: Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents
articles.abstract: Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA improves source-conditioned scientific QA by 0.381/5 over passage retrieval while remaining close to Full Compact (0.078/5 lower on average). In directed cross-paper reasoning, qualification improves by 0.184/5 over passage retrieval; Top-5 synthesis shows mixed quality effects. Across all paired RQ2 tasks, including Top-5, input+output tokens decrease by 28.5% relative to passage retrieval and 95.3% relative to Full Compact. In idea generation, a 0.067-point lower Overall score than Full Compact accompanies 93.7% fewer input+output tokens. Together, these results support SPRA as a usable representation of scientific content and a foundation for research workflows that connect, inspect, and reuse paper-level research objects. The SPRA resource is accessible through the SciVerse scholarly-data platform.

articles.titleCn: 智能体需要一种新型论文吗？SPRA：面向智能体的结构化论文表示
articles.abstractCn: 科学代理必须将分散在叙事性文章中的研究问题、方法和成果联系起来。我们介绍了SPRA（用于代理的论文级结构化表示），这是一种持久性研究对象和类型化关系的论文级表示。其经验性人工智能特征组织了问题、贡献、组件、实验设置、测量和发现，用于查询、遍历和重用。选定的论文级引用关系记录了依赖关系、组件使用以及与先前工作的比较；来源位置支持验证。我们在超过一百万篇人工智能论文中实例化了SPRA，包含1995万个研究单元和2407万个内部关系。评估通过在推理前固定任务证据的Schema-RAG访问SPRA。在七个子领域内，SPRA将条件于来源的科学问答比段落检索提高了0.381/5，同时接近全紧凑表示（平均低0.078/5）。在定向跨论文推理中，资格比段落检索提高了0.184/5；Top-5综合显示出混合质量效果。在所有配对的RQ2任务中，包括Top-5，输入+输出标记相对于段落检索减少了28.5%，相对于全紧凑表示减少了95.3%。在想法生成中，与全紧凑表示相比，整体得分低0.067分，输入+输出标记减少了93.7%。综合来看，这些结果支持SPRA作为科学内容的可用表示，以及连接、检查和重用论文级研究对象的科研工作流程的基础。SPRA资源可通过SciVerse学术数据平台访问。

articles.title: Identifying Effective Strategies in Prompt Evolution for Stress and Emotion Prediction
articles.abstract: Early stress detection and risk prediction are crucial for timely mental health assessment and support. While large language models have recently shown promise for social media stress prediction, relying on accuracy can obscure false positives. Also, prompt revisions yield inconsistent gains across models and tasks, with unclear links to strategy combinations and instruction changes. By comparing six methods on social media stress and emotion data across two model sizes, we found that GEPA and its extension combining instructions from two prompts (GEPA+merge) improved prediction over initial prompts in several settings. We also identified five prompting strategies associated with development gains. These strategies included directing attention to emotional evidence, distinguishing current from past distress, illustrating indirect cues, requiring emotional context, and guiding label selection. Moreover, we documented four observations across tasks and evaluation settings. In a separate set of searches, binary stress prediction improved early, whereas multilabel emotion prediction initially declined and partly recovered. The other three concerned incorrect or conflicting instructions, gains on small comparison samples that did not hold on full development data, and changes in selected prompts' development and reported test rankings. These findings identify effective prompt evolution methods, strategy combinations associated with gains, and task and evaluation limits, providing guidance for applying prompt evolution methods to social media stress detection.
articles.comment: 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2027)
articles.titleCn: 识别压力和情绪预测中提示进化的有效策略
articles.abstractCn: 早期压力检测和风险预测对于及时的心理健康评估和支持至关重要。虽然大型语言模型最近在社交媒体压力预测方面显示出潜力，但依赖准确率可能会掩盖误报。此外，提示修订在不同模型和任务中产生的收益不一致，且与策略组合和指令变更之间的联系不明确。通过比较六种方法在社交媒体压力和情绪数据上的表现，涵盖两种模型规模，我们发现GEPA及其结合两个提示指令的扩展版本（GEPA+merge）在多种情况下提升了预测效果，超越了初始提示。我们还识别出五种与发展收益相关的提示策略，包括引导注意力关注情绪证据、区分当前与过去的痛苦、说明间接线索、要求情绪背景以及指导标签选择。此外，我们在不同任务和评估设置中记录了四项观察结果。在一组独立的搜索中，二分类压力预测效果早期提升，而多标签情绪预测最初下降并部分恢复。其他三项涉及错误或冲突的指令、在小规模比较样本上的收益在完整发展数据上不成立，以及选定提示的发展变化和报告的测试排名变化。这些发现确定了有效的提示进化方法、与收益相关的策略组合，以及任务和评估的局限性，为将提示进化方法应用于社交媒体压力检测提供了指导。

articles.title: Beyond Invariance: Factor-wise Selective Treatment of Shifts for Multimodal Learning
articles.abstract: Distribution shifts pose a fundamental challenge to robust multimodal learning. Existing methods typically promote invariance by suppressing environment-dependent variations, implicitly applying a uniform treatment to shifted information. However, shifted information can have different predictive consequences: some contributes little to prediction, some remains reliably informative, and some exhibits environment-dependent predictive effects. This raises a fundamental question: which shifted information should be suppressed, preserved, or attenuated? To address this question, we propose FaShift, a factor-wise shift framework that diagnoses latent representation factors according to their distributional changes, intervention effects, and cross-environment stability. By factorizing multimodal representations and evaluating these complementary properties, FaShift distinguishes non-predictive factors, stably predictive factors, and predictively useful but unstable factors. It then selectively suppresses, preserves, or attenuates their contributions, rather than enforcing uniform invariance. Experiments on MOSI, MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that FaShift achieves the best ID accuracy and F1 across all three datasets. Compared with the strongest competitors reporting OOD results, it improves OOD accuracy/F1 by 1.5/3.6 points on MOSI and 1.7/2.7 points on MOSEI, while achieving the best reported OOD accuracy and F1 on CH-SIMS.
articles.titleCn: 超越不变性：多模态学习中的移位因子选择性处理
articles.abstractCn: 分布偏移对鲁棒多模态学习构成了基本挑战。现有方法通常通过抑制环境依赖性变化来促进不变性，对偏移信息隐式地采用统一处理。然而，偏移信息可能具有不同的预测后果：有些对预测贡献不大，有些仍然可靠地提供信息，有些则表现出环境依赖的预测效应。这提出了一个基本问题：哪些偏移信息应该被抑制、保留或减弱？为解决这一问题，我们提出了FaShift，一个按因子诊断潜在表征变化的框架，该框架根据分布变化、干预效应和跨环境稳定性来诊断因子。通过分解多模态表征并评估这些互补属性，FaShift区分了非预测因子、稳定预测因子和预测有用但不稳定的因子。然后，它选择性地抑制、保留或减弱它们的贡献，而不是强制执行统一不变性。在MOSI、MOSEI和CH-SIMS上的实验表明，FaShift在所有三个数据集上实现了最佳的ID准确率和F1。与报告了OOD结果的强有力竞争者相比，它在MOSI上提高了OOD准确率/F1 1.5/3.6分，在MOSEI上提高了1.7/2.7分，同时在CH-SIMS上实现了报告的最佳OOD准确率和F1。

articles.title: Calibration Language Shapes Block-Influence Pruning in Multilingual Language Models
articles.abstract: Block Influence (BI) ranks Transformer blocks for depth pruning from their input-output cosine change, but the ranking depends on the calibration distribution. We study whether English calibration transfers to Indian languages in Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-1B, and Gemma-2-2B. English, Hindi, Marathi, and Tamil use disjoint Wikipedia articles for calibration and evaluation; every selector receives the same 150-chunk budget, and Tamil is excluded from multilingual aggregation to test cross-script transfer. Across all three models, late-block BI is 20.7-55.5% higher for the three Indian languages than for English, and every predeclared late-minus-middle contrast has a 95% bootstrap interval above zero. This mismatch changes the low-BI blocks selected for removal despite high global rank correlations. Averaging BI over equal English, Hindi, and Marathi budgets mitigates the resulting perplexity damage for Qwen at six removed blocks and for Gemma at all tested depths, including held-out Tamil. The mitigation is not universal: on Llama, balancing improves Hindi and Marathi at two removed blocks but severely harms Tamil, while larger pruning budgets select the same blocks and collapse perplexity regardless of calibration. Rank-mean and minimax-rank aggregators do not dominate the raw mean. These results support a diagnostic claim rather than a universal pruning rule: English-only BI systematically misses late-layer activity for Indian-language text, but multilingual calibration must still be validated per architecture and pruning budget.
articles.titleCn: 校准语言形状块影响剪枝在多语言语言模型中
articles.abstractCn: 块影响（BI）根据Transformer块的输入输出余弦变化对深度剪枝进行排序，但该排序依赖于校准分布。我们研究了英语校准是否能在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Llama-3.2-1B和Gemma-2-2B中的印度语言中迁移。英语、印地语、马拉地语和泰米尔语使用不同的维基百科文章进行校准和评估；每个选择器都获得相同的150块预算，并且泰米尔语被排除在多语言聚合之外以测试跨脚本迁移。在所有三个模型中，对于三种印度语言，晚块BI比英语高20.7-55.5%，并且每个预先声明的晚块-中块对比的95%引导区间都高于零。这种不匹配改变了选择移除的低BI块，尽管全局排名相关性很高。在Qwen中，对等英语、印地语和马拉地语预算的BI平均值减轻了六个移除块造成的困惑度损害，在Gemma中，在所有测试深度（包括排除的泰米尔语）上都减轻了困惑度损害。这种缓解并非普遍适用：在Llama上，平衡改进了印地语和马拉地语在两个移除块上，但严重损害了泰米尔语，而更大的剪枝预算选择了相同的块，无论校准如何，困惑度都会崩溃。排名均值和极小极大排名聚合器并不优于原始均值。这些结果支持一个诊断性主张，而不是一个普遍的剪枝规则：仅英语的BI系统性地忽略了印度语文文本的晚层活动，但多语言校准仍必须针对每个架构和剪枝预算进行验证。

articles.title: DPA-MoE: A Runtime Precision Control Framework for MoE Inference
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation by routing each token to a small set of experts, but each selected expert is still used at a fixed precision. We present DPA-MoE, a runtime precision control framework that makes routed experts any-precision. DPA-MoE encodes expert feed-forward weights as prefix-decodable chunks using SharedScale AnyBCQ, profiles per-expert reconstruction residuals offline, and allocates chunks at inference time using live router gate scores. This post-routing allocation lets a single encoded MoE checkpoint operate at multiple effective weight budgets without retraining or re-encoding. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeekMoE-16B show that DPA-MoE improves KL divergence and downstream accuracy over uniform chunk allocation at matched budgets, with modest steady-state throughput overhead in our prototype.
