articles.titleCn: DPA-MoE：一种用于MoE推理的运行时精度控制框架
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）模型通过将每个token路由到一组小专家来减少计算量，但每个被选中的专家仍然以固定精度使用。我们提出了DPA-MoE，一个运行时精度控制框架，使路由的专家能够以任意精度工作。DPA-MoE将专家前馈权重编码为使用SharedScale AnyBCQ的前缀解码块，离线分析每个专家的重构残差，并在推理时使用实时路由门控分数分配块。这种路由后的分配允许单个编码的MoE检查点在不重新训练或重新编码的情况下，在多个有效权重预算下运行。在Qwen3-30B-A3B和DeepSeekMoE-16B上的实验表明，与在匹配预算下的均匀块分配相比，DPA-MoE提高了KL散度下游准确率，并且在我们的原型中具有适度的稳态吞吐量开销。

articles.title: ESG-Kor: A Korean Dataset for ESG-related Information Extraction and Practical Use Cases
articles.abstract: With the expansion of pre-trained language model usage in recent years, the importance of datasets for performing tasks in specialized domains has significantly increased. Therefore, we have built a Korean dataset called ESG-Kor to automatically extract Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information, which has recently gained importance. ESG-Kor is a dataset consisting of a total of 118,946 sentences that extracted information on each ESG component from Korean companies' sustainability reports and manually labeled it according to objective rules provided by ESG evaluation agencies. To verify the effectiveness and applicability of the ESG-Kor dataset, classification performance was confirmed using several Korean pre-trained language models, and significant performance was obtained. Additionally, by extending the ESG classification model to documents of small and medium enterprises and extracting information based on ESG key issues and in-depth analysis, we demonstrated potential and practical use cases in the ESG field.
articles.titleCn: ESG-Kor：一个用于ESG相关信息提取和实际应用案例的韩国数据集
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，随着预训练语言模型使用的扩展，在专业领域执行任务的数据集的重要性显著增加。因此，我们构建了一个名为ESG-Kor的韩语数据集，用于自动提取近年来日益重要的环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息。ESG-Kor是一个包含总共118,946个句子的数据集，从韩国企业的可持续发展报告中提取每个ESG组成部分的信息，并根据ESG评估机构提供的客观规则进行人工标注。为了验证ESG-Kor数据集的有效性和适用性，我们使用多个韩语预训练语言模型确认了分类性能，并取得了显著性能。此外，通过将ESG分类模型扩展到中小企业文档，并根据ESG关键问题和深入分析提取信息，我们在ESG领域展示了其潜力和实际应用案例。

articles.title: RenoLayout: Unified Floorplan Renovation and Furniture Layout for Constraint-Aware Residential Design
articles.abstract: Residential design aims to transform existing homes into functional living spaces while satisfying diverse design preferences and physical constraints. However, existing floorplan generation methods typically assume empty building boundaries as input, whereas renovation requires reasoning over existing floorplans. Furthermore, floorplan renovation and furniture layout are commonly addressed as separate tasks, overlooking their inherent spatial dependency. Consequently, practical residential design must preserve immutable structural components while transforming editable spatial elements. It must also optimize furniture placement under design objectives and physical constraints. To address these challenges, we formulate residential design as a design-point-guided conditional generation task and propose RenoLayout, a framework that translates a pre-design residential state together with a design-point set into an executable Geometry-as-Code program. To enable controllable supervision, we construct a Design Map comprising 123 fine-grained design points covering structural renovation and furniture layout. We further introduce Difference-Grounded Design-Point Annotation to derive design-point sets automatically from before--after design pairs with VLM-based consistency verification. RenoLayout is trained using a three-stage CPT--SFT--RL pipeline, progressively improving spatial reasoning, instruction following, and constraint compliance. We also introduce the RenoLayout Benchmark, a set of 200 real-world before--after renovation cases with complete furniture layouts. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first benchmark for unified residential design. These cases include design-critical structural and building-service constraints.
articles.titleCn: RenoLayout：面向约束感知住宅设计的统一平面布局翻新与家具布局
articles.abstractCn: 住宅设计旨在将现有房屋转化为实用生活空间，同时满足多样化的设计偏好和物理限制。然而，现有的平面图生成方法通常假设空置的建筑边界作为输入，而翻新则需要推理现有平面图。此外，平面图翻新和家具布局通常作为独立任务处理，忽略了它们之间固有的空间依赖性。因此，实际住宅设计必须在保留不可变结构组件的同时，改造可编辑的空间元素。它还必须在设计目标和物理限制下优化家具布局。为应对这些挑战，我们将住宅设计表述为一个设计点引导的条件生成任务，并提出RenoLayout框架，该框架将预设计住宅状态与设计点集转化为可执行的几何代码程序。为实现可控的监督，我们构建了包含123个细粒度设计点的设计地图，涵盖结构翻新和家具布局。我们进一步引入基于差异的地面设计点标注，从前后设计对中自动推导设计点集，并基于视觉语言模型进行一致性验证。RenoLayout通过三阶段CPT-SFT-RL流程进行训练，逐步提升空间推理、指令遵循和约束合规能力。我们还引入了RenoLayout基准，包含200个真实世界的前后翻新案例，具有完整的家具布局。据我们所知，这是首个统一的住宅设计基准。这些案例包括设计关键的结构和建筑服务约束。

articles.title: Emotion Is Not External Knowledge: Internal Attention Signals for Affective State Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate in multi-turn interactions that require maintaining latent conversational states, not only explicit facts. We study affective state as an implicit state inferred from sparse contextual cues that remain relevant after topic shifts, and ask whether LLMs expose internal attention signals for routing such evidence at inference time. Prior attention interventions rely on labeled in-domain head profiles and externally specified target spans, limiting transfer across affective-evidence distributions. We propose Self-targeted Internal Attention Boosting (SIAB), which localizes sparse affective heads via causal localization (in detail activation patching) on synthetic minimal pairs and boosts, at the answer position, the content tokens these heads already attend to; both edited heads and target tokens are derived from the model's own behavior, enabling the same head set to be reused across tasks.We evaluate on ECC and GoEmotions across three LLMs and multiple prompting settings. Across settings, SIAB improves prompt-matched baselines by up to +10.3 macro-F1 on ECC and +5.5 on GoEmotions. Combined with PASTA-style external supervision, it achieves up to +13.84 accuracy points and +12.51 macro-F1 points, while mechanistic analyses trace the gains to sparse, emotion-enriched heads and show that layer proximity affects additivity.
articles.titleCn: 情绪不是外部知识：用于情感状态推理的内部注意力信号
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地应用于多轮交互，这些交互不仅需要保持显式的信息，还需要维持潜在的对话状态。我们研究情感状态，将其视为从在主题转换后仍然相关的稀疏上下文线索中推断出的隐式状态，并探讨LLMs是否在推理时暴露内部注意力信号，用于路由此类证据。先前的注意力干预依赖于领域内标记的头部配置和外部指定的目标跨度，这限制了跨情感证据分布的迁移。我们提出了自目标内部注意力增强（SIAB），该技术通过在合成最小对上进行因果定位（详细激活补丁）来定位稀疏的情感头部，并在答案位置增强这些头部已经关注的內容标记；编辑后的头部和目标标记都源自模型自身的表现，使得同一头部集可以在不同任务中重复使用。我们在ECC和GoEmotions上使用三种LLMs和多种提示设置进行评估。在所有设置中，SIAB将匹配提示的基线在ECC上提高了高达+10.3的宏观F1，在GoEmotions上提高了+5.5。结合PASTA风格的的外部监督，它实现了高达+13.84的准确度点和+12.51的宏观F1点，而机制分析将收益归因于稀疏、情感丰富的头部，并表明层间距影响加性。

articles.title: OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
articles.abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones. To assess individual operations, we propose OpCredit, an operationaware policy-learning framework that combines downstream outcome credit with immediate transition credit: Branch Outcome Credit (BOC) reuses ordinary rollouts to compare terminal task rewards observed after different operations under matched navigation contexts; Frontier Transition Credit (FTC) measures operation-induced changes in answer-conditioned frontier potential. The two complementary signals jointly supervise the corresponding decision spans during training, while inference uses only the learned policy and standard KG interface. Experiments on ComplexWebQuestions, WebQSP, and GrailQA across three backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in KGQA performance.
articles.titleCn: OpCredit：面向自主知识图谱问答的感知操作策略学习
articles.abstractCn: 基于可执行操作的代理知识图谱问答（KGQA）依赖于一系列操作，但轨迹级别的奖励模糊了它们各自的贡献。成功的轨迹可能包含无效的操作，而失败的轨迹可能包含有用的操作。为了评估单个操作，我们提出了OpCredit，一个操作感知策略学习框架，它结合了下游结果信用和即时转换信用：分支结果信用（BOC）重用常规推进来比较在匹配导航环境下不同操作后观察到的终端任务奖励；前沿转换信用（FTC）测量操作引起的条件前沿潜力的变化。这两种互补信号在训练期间共同监督相应的决策范围，而在推理时仅使用学习到的策略和标准KG接口。在ComplexWebQuestions、WebQSP和GrailQA上针对三个主干进行的实验展示了KGQA性能的一致性提升。

articles.title: Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning
articles.abstract: We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to new tasks.
articles.titleCn: 注意力头的排名和划分在稀疏和持续强化学习微调中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过注意力头排序和划分来研究稀疏和持续强化学习对语言模型的微调。对于稀疏学习，我们通过梯度范数对注意力头进行排序，以识别一小部分可以高效训练的头部。对于持续学习，我们在任务间划分头部，以减少跨任务干扰并保留先前学习的能力。理论上，我们将梯度范数与训练有效性联系起来，并进一步阐述为什么稀疏、分离的头部更新可以保持稳定。实证上，在数学、指令跟随和编码任务中，调整排名较高的头部始终优于调整排名较低的头部，同时经常与更密集的基线相匹配，而头部划分提高了保留率，同时保留了适应新任务的能力。

articles.title: QuasiLeak-Bench: Evaluating LLM-Based Privacy Detectors on Policy-Conditioned Quasi-Evidence Group Recovery
articles.abstract: Natural language messages often contain quasi-identifiers that are weak in isolation but can jointly reveal an individual's private attributes. We call such a jointly revealing set of cues a quasi-evidence group. Existing privacy benchmarks focus on explicit identifiers, attribute inference, or task-driven disclosures, leaving inference from quasi-evidence groups largely unmeasured. In practice, whether exposing such a quasi-evidence group violates privacy also depends on sender-specified disclosure policies. We introduce QuasiLeak-Bench, a benchmark for policy-conditioned quasi-evidence group recovery, which evaluates whether detectors recover complete quasi-evidence groups and flag the disclosures the given policy prohibits. To obtain reliable ground truth at scale, a reverse-construction pipeline first selects weak quasi-identifiers, composes them into quasi-evidence groups verified to jointly reveal a target attribute, and generates documents around this evidence, followed by automated quality control. Experiments show that existing privacy detectors transfer poorly to QuasiLeak-Bench, and locally deployable LLM-based detectors fall far behind proprietary models, mainly because they miss most quasi-evidence groups altogether. However, a 4B model fine-tuned on our training split surpasses the strongest prompted model on held-out documents, showing that the task is learnable.
articles.titleCn: 准泄漏基准测试：评估基于大型语言模型的隐私检测器在策略约束准证据组恢复上的表现
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言消息中常包含准标识符，这些标识符单独看强度较弱，但联合起来可以揭示个体的隐私属性。我们将这种联合揭示隐私属性的一组线索称为准证据组。现有的隐私基准主要关注显式标识符、属性推断或任务驱动的披露，而准证据组的推断能力却鲜有衡量。在实践中，是否披露此类准证据组侵犯隐私，还取决于发送者指定的披露策略。我们引入了QuasiLeak-Bench，这是一个用于策略条件下的准证据组恢复的基准，用于评估检测器是否能够恢复完整的准证据组，并标记出被给定策略禁止的披露。为了大规模获取可靠的基准数据，我们设计了一个逆向构建流程：首先选择弱准标识符，将它们组合成联合揭示目标属性的准证据组，并围绕这些证据生成文档，随后进行自动化质量控制。实验表明，现有的隐私检测器在QuasiLeak-Bench上的迁移效果不佳，基于LLM的本地部署检测器远远落后于专有模型，主要原因在于它们完全遗漏了大多数准证据组。然而，一个在我们训练集上微调的4B模型在保留文档上超过了最强的提示模型，表明这项任务是可学习的。

articles.title: VoteGEO-Bench: Measuring the Impact of Generative Engine Optimization on Electoral Visibility
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for election information, yet little is known about how external web content shapes the political information they present. Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content to improve its visibility in generated responses. To investigate its potential risks in voting scenarios (VoteGEO), we introduce VoteGEO-Bench, a benchmark covering the 2024 U.S. presidential election and the 2026 Japanese House of Representatives election, combining election-related queries, historical webpages, and voter personas. We first analyze sources cited by generative engines and find that many citations come from lower-cost owned and open-platform sources, while some webpages remain visible across days. We then evaluate 11 rewriting strategies in 4 categories, examining target specification, effectiveness across engines and elections, and the role of voter personas. Rewriting without specifying a target rarely increases target exposure, whereas target-specified rewriting more often does. Strategies that improve page organization or strengthen a position through argumentation yield greater gains than adding supporting evidence or changing wording. For the two strongest strategies, gains remain broadly positive across evaluated U.S. personas, but persona conditioning shows no consistent effect on these gains. Explicit partisan identities can create baseline exposure gaps larger than the gain from rewriting one webpage. When partisanship is implicit in the voter profile, baseline shifts depend on how strongly the engine responds to that signal.
articles.titleCn: VoteGEO-Bench：衡量生成式引擎优化对选举可见度的影响
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在选举信息处理中应用日益广泛，但对其呈现的政治信息如何受外部网络内容影响，目前知之甚少。生成引擎优化（GEO）通过改写网络内容来提升其在生成响应中的可见度。为探究其在投票场景（VoteGEO）中的潜在风险，我们引入VoteGEO-Bench，这是一个涵盖2024年美国总统选举和2026年日本众议院选举的基准，结合了选举相关查询、历史网页和选民画像。我们首先分析了生成引擎引用的来源，发现许多引用来自低成本的自有和开放平台，而一些网页在多日仍保持可见。随后，我们在四个类别中评估了11种改写策略，考察了目标指定、跨引擎和选举的有效性，以及选民画像的作用。未指定目标的改写很少增加目标曝光度，而指定目标的改写则更常见。通过优化页面组织或通过论证强化立场策略带来的收益，通常大于添加支持证据或改变措辞。对于两种最强的策略，在评估的多个美国画像中收益普遍为正，但画像条件化对这些收益没有持续影响。显性党派身份可以造成比改写一个网页带来的收益更大的基线曝光度差距。当党派倾向隐含在选民画像中时，基线变化取决于引擎对该信号的反应强度。

articles.title: Hybrid Generative-Tagging Decoding for Efficient Product Attribute-Value Extraction
articles.abstract: Attribute-value extraction is important for building high-quality product catalogs in e-commerce. Existing systems either rely on generative or tagging strategies for extracting the attribute names and their corresponding values. Tagging models directly label spans in the source, making them fast and grounded, but they cannot produce values that require reformatting or generate rare attribute names outside their label space. Generative models avoid these drawbacks by generating both attribute names and values token by token, but this auto-regressive nature makes them slow and limits attribute coverage. We introduce hybrid generative-tagging decoding, a novel model architecture that combines tagging source spans and open-ended generation. For frequent attributes whose values are copyable, a tagging head extracts values directly from the source. This lets the generative head focus on the remainder - rare attributes outside the tagger's label space and non-copyable values, including implicit or normalized values. Integrated into vLLM inference, the hybrid decoder raises attribute coverage by 10% and extracts 63% more correct attribute-value pairs at no precision cost, while reducing latency by 44%.
articles.titleCn: 混合生成-标注解码用于高效产品属性-值提取
articles.abstractCn: 属性值提取对于构建高质量的商品目录至关重要。现有系统或依赖生成策略或标记策略来提取属性名称及其对应值。标记模型直接对源文本中的片段进行标注，使其快速且可靠，但它们无法生成需要重新格式化的值，也无法生成标记空间之外的罕见属性名称。生成模型通过逐个生成属性名称和值来避免这些缺点，但其自回归特性使其速度变慢，并限制了属性覆盖范围。我们引入了混合生成-标记解码，这是一种结合了标记源片段和开放式生成的新型模型架构。对于值可复制的常用属性，标记头直接从源中提取值。这使得生成头可以专注于其余部分——标记器标签空间之外的罕见属性和非可复制值，包括隐含值或标准化值。集成到vLLM推理中，混合解码器将属性覆盖率提高了10%，同时在不牺牲精度的前提下提取了63%更多的正确属性值对，并将延迟降低了44%。

articles.title: DocPilot: Interactive Agent Orchestration and Training for Long Visual Document Understanding
articles.abstract: Multimodal long-document question answering requires models to seek sparse evidence across pages and modalities, understand heterogeneous document content, and reason over the collected evidence. Even advanced vision-language models (VLMs) can overlook sparse evidence and struggle with cross-modal reasoning in a single pass. Existing document agents further introduce multi-step interaction, but some still rely on predefined workflows or coarse-grained actions, limiting the flexibility and granularity of document reasoning. We introduce DocPilot, an agentic document framework that supports expressive orchestration and makes complex document solving learnable by small language models (SLMs). DocPilot orchestrates evidence seeking through page-level navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, and integrates local visual inspection, code-based numerical reasoning, and cross-modal reasoning for multimodal understanding. To transfer these capabilities to small models, we propose curriculum-based agentic training that progresses from single-ability learning to adaptive orchestration through supervision from data-grounded reasoning traces and executable interaction trajectories. Across MMLongBench-Doc, DocBench, FinRAGBench-V, and MADQA, DocPilot achieves strong gains with frontier VLM backbones, while DocPilot-4B delivers competitive performance against substantially larger models, demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization across diverse long-document reasoning settings. The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot.
articles.titleCn: DocPilot：用于长视觉文档理解的交互式代理编排与训练
articles.abstractCn: 多模态长文档问答需要模型跨页和跨模态寻找稀疏证据、理解异构文档内容，并对收集的证据进行推理。即使是先进的视觉语言模型（VLMs）也可能忽略稀疏证据，并在单次处理中难以进行跨模态推理。现有的文档代理进一步引入了多步交互，但其中一些仍然依赖预定义的工作流程或粗粒度动作，限制了文档推理的灵活性和粒度。我们介绍了DocPilot，这是一个支持表达性编排的智能文档框架，通过小型语言模型（SLMs）使复杂文档求解变得可学习。DocPilot通过页面级导航和细粒度证据定位来编排证据寻找，并整合局部视觉检查、基于代码的数值推理和跨模态推理，以实现多模态理解。为了将这些能力迁移到小型模型，我们提出了基于课程的智能训练方法，通过数据驱动的推理轨迹和可执行的交互轨迹的监督，从单一能力学习到自适应编排。在MMLongBench-Doc、DocBench、FinRAGBench-V和MADQA等基准测试中，DocPilot在使用前沿VLM主干网络时取得了显著提升，而DocPilot-4B在性能上与远超其规模的模型相比具有竞争力，展示了其在各种长文档推理场景中的强大有效性和泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DocPilot获取。

articles.title: ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer
articles.abstract: Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, which scores caption-derived atomic claims on two blind anchors--source image (truthfulness) and reconstruction (realizability)--separating fabrication from generator loss claim by claim; human and multi-judge comparisons complement this fact-level view. Against Qwen3.5-397B-A17B captions, ZoomCap achieves an 81.9% human tie-adjusted preference score with a teacher over 10x smaller, and FactCycle counts 52.4 transferred claims per image vs. 31.5 for ScaleCap. The evidence also transfers: in continual pre-training, ZoomCap-450K improves the 11-benchmark average by 1.31-2.38 points over the strongest competing corpus and Ling-Tiny-VL-v3 gains 1.4 points on a production document/OCR monitor suite (1.5 on perception) at 60B tokens; in medical pre-training, 2.64M ZoomCap-captioned images improve five VQA benchmarks by 3.04 points (vs. 1.76 for same-image Gemini-3.1-Pro captions).
articles.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables; technical report. ZoomCap-450K is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MasterHow/ZoomCap-450K
articles.titleCn: ZoomCap：基于证据引导的视觉缩放，用于可恢复的视觉信息传输
articles.abstractCn: 详细说明文字将视觉信息转化为视觉语言模型的监督信息，但质量容易与长度混淆：长单次输出的说明文字仍然会遗漏小物体、文字和空间关系，或者将不确定的观察结果提升为自信的断言。我们将细粒度说明文字定义为可恢复的视觉信息传递，其中教师节点在有限的观察预算下获取缺失的证据并将其转化为可重复使用的监督信息。ZoomCap使用草稿说明文字来引导条件知识检索、OCR敏感阅读、覆盖范围缺失恢复和自适应视觉缩放，仅将更深层的裁剪分配给最复杂的合格区域，从基于几何的锚定中推导空间关系，并融合非重复证据。我们还引入了FactCycle，该工具对基于说明文字生成的原子断言在两个盲锚点——源图像（真实性）和重建图像（可实现性）——上进行评分，逐条区分捏造与生成器损失声称；人工和多评委比较补充了这一事实层面的视角。与Qwen3.5-397B-A17B说明文字相比，ZoomCap在拥有10倍更小教师节点的情况下，实现了81.9%的人工调整偏好得分，FactCycle每张图像转移52.4条断言，而ScaleCap为31.5条。证据也能转移：在持续预训练中，ZoomCap-450K比最强的竞争语料库平均提高了1.31-2.38分，Ling-Tiny-VL-v3在60B token的生产文档/OCR监控套件上（感知方面为1.5分）提高了1.4分；在医疗预训练中，264万ZoomCap说明文字标注的图像使五个VQA基准平均提高了3.04分（与相同图像的Gemini-3.1-Pro说明文字标注的1.76分相比）。

articles.title: PocketTSLM: Deploying an On-Device Soft-Prompt Time-Series Language Model for Privacy-Preserving Smartphone Reasoning
articles.abstract: Consumer phones and wearables increasingly collect physiological time-series data, yet most mobile systems treat these streams as summaries or text rather than as temporal evidence. This representation is poorly matched to personal health systems that need to retrieve, route, or summarize sensor evidence while preserving temporal structure. Cloud-hosted time-series language models avoid smartphone limits, but they repeatedly move sensitive physiology off the device and add latency and per-query compute cost. Mobile model alternatives that aggregate time-series data into statistical features or serialize raw samples as text either compress temporal structure or exhaust the context and memory budgets of small on-device models. We present PocketTSLM, a mobile-native deployment of OpenTSLM SoftPrompt, the soft-prompt variant of the OpenTSLM time-series language model. PocketTSLM runs fully on a consumer smartphone by injecting encoded time-series windows as embeddings instead of tokenizing time series as text. A numerical parity protocol verifies identical greedy-decoded token sequences between the Swift port and a Python reference using Apple's MLX machine-learning framework. Answers also match the PyTorch reference, although rationale wording can differ. An on-device context-economics benchmark compares the soft-prompt path with a text-serialized baseline on the same backbone. In our benchmark format, soft-prompting uses approximately 12 times fewer time-series tokens and reduces prompt-prefill cost. PocketTSLM processes 30-second Sleep-EDF electroencephalography clips for sleep staging and a 1,000-sample (10 s) 12-lead electrocardiogram clip from ECG-QA. In comparison, text-serialized baselines exceed the phone's context or memory budget at longer time-series windows. All inference runs entirely on the device, with no health data transmitted during inference.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. A version of this paper was accepted at the Workshop on Deploying AI in Healthcare (DAIH) at COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/SchmiedmayerLab/PocketTSLM
articles.titleCn: PocketTSLM：在设备上部署用于隐私保护智能手机推理的软提示时间序列语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 消费级手机和可穿戴设备越来越多地收集生理时间序列数据，然而大多数移动系统将这些数据流视为摘要或文本，而非时间证据。这种表示方式与需要检索、路由或总结传感器证据同时保留时间结构的个人健康系统匹配度不佳。云托管的时间序列语言模型规避了智能手机的限制，但它们反复将敏感生理数据移出设备，并增加了延迟和每查询的计算成本。将时间序列数据聚合为统计特征或将原始样本序列化为文本的移动模型替代方案要么压缩了时间结构，要么耗尽了小规模设备模型的上下文和内存预算。我们提出了PocketTSLM，这是OpenTSLM SoftPrompt的移动原生部署，OpenTSLM SoftPrompt是OpenTSLM时间序列语言模型的软提示变体。PocketTSLM通过将编码的时间序列窗口注入嵌入，而非将时间序列文本化，完全在消费级智能手机上运行。数值一致性协议验证了Swift端口和Python参考之间使用Apple的MLX机器学习框架进行贪婪解码的相同标记序列。答案也与PyTorch参考匹配，尽管推理文本可能不同。设备上下文经济基准比较了软提示路径与在同一骨干上的文本序列化基线。在我们的基准格式中，软提示使用的时间序列标记大约减少了12倍，并降低了提示预填充成本。PocketTSLM处理用于睡眠分期分析的30秒Sleep-EDF脑电图片段，以及来自ECG-QA的1000样本（10秒）12导心电图片段。相比之下，文本序列化基线在更长的时间序列窗口下超出了手机的上下文或内存预算。所有推理完全在设备上运行，推理过程中未传输任何健康数据。

articles.title: VALCON: Benchmarking and Enhancing Value Consistency in Large Language Models via Dual-Role Variation
articles.abstract: Current value alignment evaluations for large language models (LLMs) heavily rely on output compliance, overlooking whether LLMs maintain value consistency when alternating between generator and evaluator roles. Such consistency is increasingly important because modern LLM agents and alignment pipelines often rely on the same LLM to both generate actions and evaluate their acceptability. To mitigate this limitation, we propose VALCON, a role-driven data construction framework that operationalizes value consistency into three benchmark suites (VAB-Consistency, VAB-Boundary, VAB-Challenge) via dual-role variation. By systematically pairing an LLM's generative behavior with its evaluative judgments under identical principles, VALCON synthesizes target evaluation data that exposes hidden value discrepancies. Experiments on 28 LLMs reveal pervasive cross-role inconsistency: models with highly compliant outputs frequently fail to align their judgments with their own generations. To understand and address this gap, we perform mechanistic probing that uncovers a role-dependent representational decoupling associated with this behavioral asymmetry. Guided by these insights, we propose a representation-directed intervention that effectively mitigates consistency failures. Our work establishes value consistency as a distinct alignment dimension and provides a complete evaluation-analysis-mitigation pipeline. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/VALCON.
articles.comment: 24 pages, 16 figures. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/VALCON
articles.titleCn: VALCON：通过双重角色变化在大语言模型中基准测试和增强价值一致性
articles.abstractCn: 当前对大型语言模型（LLM）的价值观对齐评估严重依赖于输出合规性，忽视了LLM在生成器和评估器角色之间切换时是否保持价值观的一致性。这种一致性越来越重要，因为现代LLM代理和对其可接受性进行评估的管道通常依赖于同一个LLM来生成行为并评估其可接受性。为了弥补这一局限性，我们提出了VALCON，这是一个基于角色的数据构建框架，通过双重角色变化将价值观一致性操作化为三个基准套件（VAB-一致性、VAB-边界、VAB-挑战）。通过系统地配对LLM在相同原则下的生成行为和评估判断，VALCON综合了暴露隐藏价值观差异的目标评估数据。在28个LLM上的实验揭示了普遍的跨角色不一致性：输出高度合规的模型经常无法使其判断与其自身生成保持一致。为了理解和解决这一差距，我们进行了机制探测，揭示了与这种行为不对称性相关的角色依赖性表征解耦。基于这些见解，我们提出了一个表征导向的干预措施，有效缓解了一致性失败问题。我们的工作将价值观一致性确立为一个独特的对齐维度，并提供了一个完整的评估-分析-缓解管道。代码和数据可在https://github.com/tjunlp-lab/VALCON获取。

articles.title: Making every stage of medical device document assessment with large language models deterministic
articles.abstract: To show that a medical device complies with regulation, experts judge whether documents and records meet each requirement and record the judgment for others to verify. For each assessment item that experts define, large language models could prepare a preliminary assessment: a label such as Satisfied or Not satisfied, a reason and quoted evidence. We sent fourteen commercial deployments of such models (seven models from three providers, through six routes) the same request repeatedly, with the deterministic sampling settings each accepted; every deployment returned differing assessments for at least one request, and in twelve the label changed. Reducing reasoning where the interface allows it did not reduce the variation, and prompts of retrieved passages removed it only for the smallest models. The same open-weight model was reproducible or not depending only on how it was served. A pipeline we built to be deterministic at every stage -- text extraction and optical character recognition (OCR), chunking, embedding, indexing, retrieval and inference -- returned byte-identical output at each stage across reruns, interruptions, edits, machines of one graphics processing unit (GPU) model and days, for blood glucose meter and infusion pump documents. OCR, embedding and approximate retrieval varied when their own serving was not made invariant, and outputs changed with the GPU model and with the inference engine's scheduling settings, which therefore belong in the recorded configuration. End-to-end determinism is achievable and gives a testable basis for audit and change control.
articles.comment: 30 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables; supplementary tables S1-S15 and two supplementary notes included
articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型使医疗设备文件评估的每个阶段都确定无疑
articles.abstractCn: 为证明医疗设备符合法规要求，专家需判断文件和记录是否满足各项要求，并将判断结果记录供他人核查。对于专家定义的每个评估项，大型语言模型可以准备初步评估：包括标签（如“符合”或“不符合”）、理由和引用的证据。我们向十四个商业部署的大型语言模型（来自三家供应商的七个模型，通过六条路径）重复发送相同请求，且每次都采用确定的采样设置；每个部署至少对一项请求返回了不同的评估结果，其中十二项的标签发生了变化。当界面允许时减少推理并未减少差异，而检索到的段落提示仅在最小模型上消除了差异。相同的开放权重模型是否可复现，仅取决于其服务方式。我们构建的流水线在每一步都保持确定性——包括文本提取和光学字符识别（OCR）、分块、嵌入、索引、检索和推理——在重跑、中断、编辑、同型号图形处理单元（GPU）的机器以及不同日期下，对血糖仪和输液泵文档的输出在每个阶段都返回了字节完全相同的输出。OCR、嵌入和近似检索在它们自己的服务未保持不变时会产生变化，输出结果会随GPU型号和推理引擎的调度设置而改变，因此这些应记录在配置中。端到端的确定性是可实现的，并为审计和变更控制提供了可测试的基础。

articles.title: Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation
articles.abstract: Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. The framework implements bias control by presenting one style-normalized reasoning trace per distinct answer, and bias injection by placing each aggregating agent's initially selected answer in the minority. Overall, our framework achieves higher average accuracy and better token efficiency than competing non-oracle aggregation methods across three mathematical reasoning benchmarks and four heterogeneous LLM combinations. It also improves final-answer accuracy when applied to multi-agent debate and Mixture-of-Agents, without modifying their interaction or synthesis processes.
articles.titleCn: 多智能体聚合中的偏差控制与注入
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的多智能体推理为集体决策提出了一个核心问题：当智能体意见不一致时，应信任哪个决策？解决此类分歧之所以困难，是因为智能体的决策容易受到诸如多数压力和回应风格偏好等非语义偏见的干扰，这些偏见会掩盖潜在推理的质量。我们的分析表明，偏见既可被缓解也可被利用：偏见控制可提升初始答案选择，而偏见注入则能引发决策不稳定，这种不稳定可作为可靠性信号。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种测试时聚合框架，该框架既不需要验证数据，也不需要事先了解相对模型强度。该框架通过为每个不同答案呈现一个风格归一化的推理轨迹来实现偏见控制，并通过将每个聚合智能体最初选择的答案置于少数来实现偏见注入。总体而言，我们的框架在三个数学推理基准和四种异构LLM组合中，比竞争的非神谕聚合方法实现了更高的平均准确率和更好的token效率。此外，当将其应用于多智能体辩论和智能体混合时，它还能提高最终答案的准确率，而无需修改它们的交互或合成过程。

articles.title: TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data
articles.abstract: Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an open deterministic captioning pipeline with three reusable extractor tiers and a cross-channel synthesis layer that operates directly on the signal with no language model in the loop, extensible to new schemas by writing channel definitions alone. This positions TimeCap as a reproducible mechanism for future dataset generation rather than a one-off release. Applying TimeCap to OpenMHC, the MyHeart Counts wearable dataset, yields MHCap, the largest open caption layer for multimodal wearable time-series data. MHCap spans 19 Apple HealthKit channels and 7,005,763 captions over 908,944 person-days. To showcase the impact of the corpus, we train OpenTSLM, a time-series language model, on MHCap and benchmark on health-outcome prediction. Caption-augmented training (OpenTSLM-Cap) outperforms a label-only baseline on 29 of 32 per-user binary evaluations across 8 tasks.
articles.comment: 46 pages, 27 figures, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/SchmiedmayerLab/TimeCAP
articles.titleCn: TimeCap：一个可扩展的开源流程，用于对可穿戴健康时间序列数据进行字幕描述
articles.abstractCn: 跨工业、环境和尤其是健康领域持续生成的时序数据产生了多模态信号，其规模和异质性使得数据处理和解释尤为具有挑战性。时序语言模型（TSLMs）承诺对这些信号进行可扩展的解释，但仍然受到缺乏基于信号的、可重复生成且跨模态和模式可扩展的文本标注时序数据对的根本性瓶颈限制。现有的配对语料库要么是封闭的，要么在规模和模态覆盖范围上有限。使用大型语言模型进行标注可以扩展其规模，但其输出无法精确再生，这阻碍了其他人重新推导、扩展或审计生成的语料库。为解决这一问题，我们发布了TimeCap，这是一个开放式的确定性描述管道，包含三个可重用的提取层和一个跨通道合成层，该层直接在信号上运行，不涉及语言模型，仅通过编写通道定义即可扩展到新的模式。这使得TimeCap成为未来数据集生成的可重复机制，而不仅仅是单次发布。将TimeCap应用于OpenMHC，即MyHeart Counts可穿戴数据集，生成了MHCap，这是目前最大的开放式多模态可穿戴时序数据描述层。MHCap涵盖了19个Apple HealthKit通道，并在908,944人天中包含了7,005,763条描述。为展示语料库的影响，我们在MHCap上训练了时序语言模型OpenTSLM，并在健康结果预测上进行基准测试。描述增强训练（OpenTSLM-Cap）在8项任务中的32项用户级二元评估中有29项优于仅使用标签的基线。

articles.title: Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures
articles.abstract: Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but does not remove the gap, falling from 0.97 clean accuracy to 0.78 under conflict. Verbalized confidence is inconsistent (ECE 0.10--0.54; failure AUROC 0.48--0.77), and a development-tuned confidence-only policy yields no utility gain. A transparent workflow-aware controller improves 5:1 utility for every model and reduces missed escalations to 0.12--0.24, at specificity 0.83--0.93. However, a 30-concept lexical stress test reduces each rule detector's recall from 1.00 on trigger phrases to 0.00 on unseen paraphrases, limiting the controller claim to this benchmark. Seed-clustered statistics, ablations, cross-task transfer, raw outputs, and manifests are packaged for audit. The results motivate explicit workflow-state evaluation while showing that apparently effective routing controls need their own generalization tests.
articles.titleCn: 在医疗领域LLM代理中审计升级可靠性：一种针对工作流状态故障的扰动控制基准
articles.abstractCn: 值得信赖的生物医学AI需要在证据缺失、过时、冲突或滞后时进行可靠的行为选择，而不仅仅是基于静态输入提供准确答案。我们实例化了一种场景级评估协议，包括400个合成医疗工作流场景：涵盖四个任务类别、两种表面参数化和五种受控变体的40个手写语义种子，在预先声明的5:1漏报与不必要升级成本下，对ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE进行评分。参考行为是单作者研究政策标签，而非临床裁决的真实情况。在五个开放权重配置（1.7B--9.7B）下，清洁决策准确率达到0.97，但不确定性提示模型漏报了32--97%的必要升级。更强的9.7B配置缩小了差距但并未消除，在冲突情况下从0.97的清洁准确率降至0.78。口头表达的置信度不一致（ECE 0.10--0.54；失败AUROC 0.48--0.77），而开发调优的仅置信度策略未带来效用提升。一个透明的流程感知控制器提高了每个模型的5:1效用，并将漏报升级减少至0.12--0.24，特异性为0.83--0.93。然而，一个包含30个概念的词汇强调测试将每个规则检测器在触发短语上的召回率从1.00降至在未见过释义上的0.00，将控制器的声明限制在此基准上。种子聚类统计、消融实验、跨任务迁移、原始输出和清单已打包用于审计。结果推动了显式流程状态评估，同时表明看似有效的路由控制需要其自身的泛化测试。

articles.title: TRACER: Trajectory-Aware Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. On a mixed retail-and-telecom $τ^2$ environment, TRACER improves GPT-5.4's tool-selection accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing input tokens per step by 80%, exposing just 5 of 128 tools. In autonomous full-turn execution, it matches GPT-5.4's full-registry task success with 61% fewer input tokens per step. Across six environments and four models, TRACER improves tool-selection accuracy over full-registry selection in 21 of 24 model-environment pairs, with average gains of 6 to 10 points; the three exceptions trail by at most 2.2. We analyze failures in both regimes to identify directions for future work.
articles.titleCn: TRACER：面向LLM智能体的轨迹感知工具检索
articles.abstractCn: 现代智能体从工具注册表中选择工具，但公开整个注册表会导致高昂的代币成本，并且随着其增长可能会损害选择能力。我们提出了TRACER，一个检索前端，它将观察到的工具调用序列索引到前缀树中，并使用学习到的经验性和上下文先验的混合方法对延续进行排序。在一个混合零售和电信的$τ^2$环境中，TRACER将GPT-5.4的工具选择准确率提高了4.7分，同时将每步输入代币数减少了80%，仅公开了128个工具中的5个。在自主全轮执行中，它以每步61%更少的输入代币数匹配了GPT-5.4的全注册表任务成功率。在六个环境和四个模型中，TRACER在24个模型-环境组合中的21个中提高了工具选择准确率，平均提升6到10分；三个例外的情况落后最多2.2分。我们分析了两种情况下的失败，以确定未来工作的方向。

articles.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) represent model activations with sparse, linearly decoded features, but the downstream effects of those features need not compose additively. We introduce SAE Additivity Residuals (SAR), which measure the behavioral variation left unexplained above a chosen interaction order. Under independent feature subset sampling, population SAR is exactly the normalized energy of interactions above that order and bounds coalition ordering error for the optimal low order approximation. To distinguish compositionality associated with the SAE representation from that induced by downstream computation, we compare learned SAE coordinates with sum preserving random rotations of the same selected subspace and find lower first order residuals for the learned coordinates across all 18 model and behavior settings. The coordinates are nevertheless not fully additive: pairwise terms improve held out coalition ordering in every setting and outperform parameter matched models using randomly selected third order terms. In a combined steering experiment, pairwise modeling raises rank fidelity from 0.5874 to 0.7790 and reduces ordering error from 0.1444 to 0.0606. Together, these results show that SAE coordinates support comparatively compositional behavioral descriptions while faithful joint explanations and interventions still require interactions beyond individual feature effects. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/SAE-Behavioral-Compositionality.
articles.titleCn: 稀疏自动编码器表示的行为组合性
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）使用稀疏、线性解码特征来表示模型激活，但这些特征的下游效应不必具有加性。我们引入了SAE加性残差（SAR），用于测量在选定交互阶数之上未被解释的行为变化。在独立特征子集采样下，群体SAR精确等于该阶数以上的交互归一化能量，并界定了最优低阶近似中的联盟排序误差。为了区分与SAE表示相关的组合性以及由下游计算诱导的组合性，我们将学习到的SAE坐标与相同选定子空间的和保持随机旋转进行比较，发现学习到的坐标在所有18个模型和行为设置中具有更低的阶数残差。然而，坐标并非完全加性：成对项在每种设置中都改进了保留的联盟排序，并优于使用随机选择的第三阶项的参数匹配模型。在一个组合转向实验中，成对建模将排序保真度从0.5874提高到0.7790，并将排序误差从0.1444降低到0.0606。这些结果共同表明，SAE坐标支持相对组合性的行为描述，而忠实联合解释和干预仍然需要超越单个特征效应的交互。代码可在https://github.com/OpenSAE/SAE-Behavioral-Compositionality获取。

articles.title: Isolating a Language Model's Judgment with a Label-Free Subspace
articles.abstract: Language models are often asked to make judgments: whether a proposed answer is correct, whether one statement follows logically from another, or whether a response is safe. Yet changing the instructions that specify how the judgment should be expressed can make the final answer less reliable, even for the same input. We ask whether this reflects a change in internal judgment or a failure to express it. Comparing hidden-state vectors for the same input under different instructions, we find that their differences concentrate in a low-dimensional expression subspace. We identify this subspace without benchmark labels and remove its contribution from a linear predictor to obtain an isolated judgment. Across correctness, entailment, and safety, the isolated judgment remains reliable under instructions not used to identify the subspace, even when the model's final answer and the original predictor degrade. When the judgment question is negated, isolation raises the predictor's AUROC from 0.504 to 0.825 for entailment and from 0.480 to 0.891 for safety. We also find that judgment is readable in earlier layers, before the expression subspace begins to disrupt the predictor. Together, these results provide a way to separate judgment from expression and recover internal judgments even when the model's final answers are unreliable.
articles.titleCn: 使用无标签子空间隔离语言模型的判断
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型经常被要求进行判断：评估一个提议的答案是否正确，判断一个陈述是否逻辑上遵循另一个陈述，或评估一个回应是否安全。然而，改变指定判断表达方式的指令可能会使最终答案的可靠性降低，即使对于相同的输入也是如此。我们探究这是否反映了内部判断的变化，还是表达上的失败。通过比较在不同指令下相同输入的隐藏状态向量，我们发现它们的差异集中在低维表达子空间中。我们无需基准标签就识别出这个子空间，并将其对线性预测器的贡献去除，从而得到一个独立的判断。在正确性、蕴涵性和安全性方面，当使用未用于识别子空间的指令时，独立的判断仍然保持可靠性，即使模型的最终答案和原始预测器性能下降。当判断问题被否定时，隔离将蕴涵性的预测器AUROC从0.504提高到0.825，将安全性的预测器AUROC从0.480提高到0.891。我们还发现，判断在表达子空间开始干扰预测器之前较早的层中是可读的。综合这些结果，提供了一种将判断与表达分离的方法，即使模型的最终答案不可靠，也能恢复内部判断。

articles.title: LLM-Based Weak Annotation for Cybersecurity Tweet Classification: A Teacher-Student Framework
articles.abstract: Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) relies on the timely identification of emerging threats, enabling organizations and security analysts to support situational awareness and decision-making. Social media platforms such as X (formerly Twitter) have become valuable CTI sources because vulnerabilities and attack activities are often discussed there before appearing in formal reports. However, the rapid growth of cybersecurity discussions on social media has created more content than domain experts can realistically review and annotate, making labeled data a major bottleneck for developing supervised learning approaches. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as weak annotators in other domains, their effectiveness for cybersecurity tweet classification and downstream training of domain-specific pre-trained language models (PLMs) remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose a Teacher-Student weak supervision framework in which a selected LLM serves as a Teacher to generate weak labels for unlabeled cybersecurity tweets, enabling the training of cybersecurity-specific PLMs without large-scale manual annotation. Experimental results show that PLMs trained solely on LLM-generated labels consistently achieve F1 scores above 0.92, remaining within 3 percentage points of fully human-supervised models across all evaluated architectures. These findings suggest that LLM-based weak annotation offers a practical alternative for constructing cybersecurity-specific training data when expert annotation resources are limited.
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的弱标注网络安全推文分类：师生框架
articles.abstractCn: 网络威胁情报（CTI）依赖于及时识别新兴威胁，使组织和安全分析师能够支持态势感知和决策制定。像X（前身为Twitter）这样的社交媒体平台已成为有价值的CTI来源，因为漏洞和攻击活动通常在这些平台上讨论，然后才会出现在正式报告中。然而，社交媒体上网络安全讨论的快速增长产生了超出领域专家实际审查和标注的内容，使得标记数据成为开发监督学习方法的主要瓶颈。虽然大型语言模型（LLM）在其他领域已显示出作为弱标注者的潜力，但它们在网络安全推文分类和特定领域预训练语言模型（PLM）的下游训练方面的有效性仍待探索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种师生弱监督框架，其中选定的LLM作为教师为未标记的网络安全推文生成弱标签，从而无需大规模人工标注即可训练网络安全专用PLM。实验结果表明，仅使用LLM生成的标签训练的PLM始终能稳定达到F1分数超过0.92，在所有评估的架构中与完全人工监督模型相差不超过3个百分点。这些发现表明，基于LLM的弱标注为在专家标注资源有限时构建网络安全专用训练数据提供了一种实用的替代方案。

articles.title: FGSS-BO: Feedback-Guided Hypothesis Management for LLM-Based Bayesian Optimization
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-guided Bayesian optimization (BO) uses past observations to guide search, but proposed directions and their revision can remain implicit. We propose Feedback-Guided Search State (FGSS), a structured hypothesis-management interface connecting language-based guidance to observed evidence, executable parameter interventions, and comparative support updates. An LLM reflector proposes and revises hypotheses; a deterministic curator validates them and maintains identities and test records. The evolving state guides candidate construction and priorities. Instantiated on LLAMBO, FGSS-BO retains its surrogate and default expected improvement selection, with a bounded testing policy. On two retrospective protocol/media tasks with nearest-neighbor response oracles, it attains higher sample mean final best and search AUC than the matched LLAMBO baseline and evaluated non-LLM baselines. Prose-reflection and EI-only controls show mixed component effects. Six direct-training hyperparameter-optimization tasks show task-dependent transfer, strongest on diabetes SVM; exact-grid and reaction controls examine other settings. FGSS exposes hypotheses, their execution, and cross-round revisions for inspection while supporting search gains in selected settings.
articles.titleCn: FGSS-BO：基于LLM的贝叶斯优化的反馈引导假设管理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）引导的贝叶斯优化（BO）利用过去的观察结果来指导搜索，但提出的方向及其修订可能仍然隐含。我们提出了反馈引导搜索状态（FGSS），这是一个结构化的假设管理界面，连接语言指导与观察证据、可执行的参数干预以及比较支持更新。LLM反射器提出并修订假设；确定性策展人验证假设并维护身份和测试记录。不断发展的状态指导候选构建和优先级。在LLAMBO上实现的FGSS-BO保留了其代理和默认预期改进选择，并具有有界测试策略。在两个具有最近邻响应神谕的回顾性协议/媒体任务中，它比匹配的LLAMBO基线和评估的非LLM基线实现了更高的样本均值最终最佳和搜索AUC。散文反思和仅EI控制显示了混合的组件效应。在六个直接训练超参数优化任务中显示了任务相关的迁移，在糖尿病SVM上最强；精确网格和反应控制检验了其他设置。FGSS暴露假设、其执行和跨轮修订以供检查，同时在选定设置中支持搜索收益。

articles.title: System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often make discrete decisions, such as flagging phishing or escalating to a human. System-1 models, such as Jev and the OpenAI Decisions API, return probabilities over options in a single forward pass, while System-2 approaches generate reasoning steps. Which decisions can System-1 models handle, and which require generative reasoning? We introduce System1-Arena, a benchmark that gives all models the same decision requests and scores their probabilities. It contains 92k questions across 105 tasks from 268 public sources, in four groups: text classification and knowledge, applied decisions, evaluation and control, and agent and action. It also includes 138 closed-loop environments, from web shopping and SWE-bench coding control to robotics, games, and driving; in real-time mode, the world evolves while a model decides. We evaluate 30 models: 7 closed LLMs, 13 open LLMs read at the answer token, and 10 System-1 models. The largest System-1 models match or exceed fast closed LLMs in non-agentic accuracy, with better-calibrated probabilities at one-quarter of the latency. A reasoning LLM is the most accurate, at about 70x the cost of a fast LLM. In closed loops, large open LLMs succeed most often (up to 32.9%); small System-1 models rarely succeed.
articles.comment: 40 pages. Code: https://github.com/TianyuCodings/S1-Arena ; leaderboard: https://tianyucodings.github.io/S1-Arena ; dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/C-Tianyu/S1-Arena
articles.titleCn: 系统1-竞技场：哪些决策可以交由系统1？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常做出离散决策，例如标记网络钓鱼或升级至人工处理。系统1模型（如Jev和OpenAI决策API）在单次前向传递中返回选项的概率，而系统2方法则生成推理步骤。系统1模型能处理哪些决策，哪些需要生成式推理？我们介绍了System1-Arena，这是一个基准测试，它向所有模型提供相同的决策请求并评分其概率。它包含来自268个公开来源的105项任务中的92k个问题，分为四组：文本分类和知识、应用决策、评估和控制、以及代理和行动。它还包括138个闭环环境，从网络购物和SWE-bench编码控制到机器人、游戏和驾驶；在实时模式下，世界在模型做出决策时演变。我们评估了30个模型：7个封闭LLM、13个在答案标记处读取的开LLM和10个系统1模型。最大的系统1模型在非代理准确性上与快速封闭LLM相当或超过，且在四分之一延迟下具有更好的校准概率。推理LLM最准确，但成本约为快速LLM的70倍。在闭环中，大型开放LLM最常成功（最高达32.9%）；小型系统1模型很少成功。

articles.title: Representation Redistribution in Sparse Autoencoders
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language model activations into sparse features, but prompt transformations designed to preserve the underlying request can redistribute activity across them. A feature change observed on one transformed prompt need not recur, and even a recurring change need not affect a downstream computation. We introduce the redistribution sensitivity score (RSS), which identifies large feature responses that recur in a consistent direction, and evaluate the resulting supports on variants excluded from selection. Across 27 pretrained SAEs spanning eight language models, the tested prompt transformations produce a reproducible redistribution profile on these excluded variants. We then separate recurring representation change from signed readout contribution and decision failure. For a fixed linear readout, an exact decomposition shows how response magnitude, readout coefficients, directional alignment, and the clean margin determine downstream consequences. In two frozen safety readouts, combining RSS support erosion with the full clean margin yields recurrent failure AUROCs of 0.935 and 0.958 using median supports of 20 and 19 features, compared with 0.965 and 0.964 using full erosion. RSS therefore provides a way to identify recurring sparse representation changes and quantify their contribution to a downstream readout without equating representation change with failure. Code is available at https://github.com/OpenSAE/Redistribution-Sensitivity-Score
articles.titleCn: 稀疏自编码器中的表示重分配
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）将语言模型激活分解为稀疏特征，但旨在保留底层请求的提示转换可能会重新分配这些特征的活动。在一个转换后的提示上观察到的特征变化不一定会重现，即使重现的变化也不一定会影响下游计算。我们引入了重新分配敏感性分数（RSS），它识别在一致方向上重复出现的较大特征响应，并评估这些响应在未被选中的变体上的支持。在涵盖八个语言模型的27个预训练SAEs中，测试的提示转换在这些被排除的变体上产生了可重复的重新分配模式。然后我们将重复出现的表示变化与符号读出贡献和决策失败分开。对于固定的线性读出，精确分解显示了响应幅度、读出系数、方向对齐和干净边缘如何决定下游后果。在两个冻结的安全读出中，结合RSS支持侵蚀和完整干净边缘产生了0.935和0.958的重复失败AUROCs，使用中位支持20和19个特征，与使用完整侵蚀的0.965和0.964相比。因此，RSS提供了一种识别重复出现的稀疏表示变化并量化其对下游读出贡献的方法，而无需将表示变化等同于失败。代码可在https://github.com/OpenSAE/Redistribution-Sensitivity-Score获取。

articles.title: What Should We Remove? Evaluating the Reliability and Costs of RLVR Data Decontamination
articles.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) math corpora are routinely screened for benchmark overlap, but the reliability and data-loss costs of cleaning policies remain underexamined. We audit sixteen open RLVR math corpora comprising 1,673,514 corpus-specific training items against six benchmarks containing 1,949 questions. We evaluate eight policies based on exact, lexical, and semantic matching using 594 independently and blindly dual-reviewed training-benchmark pairs. Calibration and held-out sets have disjoint benchmark questions and training-example families. A separate review of all 83 candidate matches for 80 sampled training items measures item-level false removal. At cosine threshold 0.80, 52 of 59 sampled removals (88%) were confirmed false removals; this is not a demonstrated population rate. No semantic threshold in our preregistered grid (0.80-0.98) meets the 90% conservative-precision target on calibration. The existing judge-adjudicated policy achieves 98.1% resolved precision and 98.2% candidate-frame recall on held-out corpora. It has zero confirmed false removals among six sampled removals, with one unresolved case; this does not establish zero risk. Within the evaluated candidate frame, this policy offers a more favorable precision-recall balance than the semantic-threshold alternatives tested. Recall does not measure contamination outside the candidate frame. We release reviewed labels, per-policy decisions, and coverage accounting to support evaluation of cleaning reliability and cost rather than overlap counts alone.
articles.titleCn: 我们应该移除什么？评估RLVR数据去污染的可靠性和成本
articles.abstractCn: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）数学语料库通常会进行基准重叠审查，但清理策略的可靠性和数据丢失成本仍缺乏研究。我们对包含1673514个语料库特定训练项目的16个公开RLVR数学语料库（针对包含1949个问题的6个基准）进行了审计。我们使用594对独立且盲法双重审查的训练-基准对，评估了基于精确匹配、词汇匹配和语义匹配的八种策略。校准集和保留集的基准问题和训练示例家族是互斥的。对80个样本训练项目的全部83个候选匹配进行了独立审查，以测量项目级别的错误移除。在余弦阈值0.80时，59个样本移除中的52个（88%）被确认为错误移除；但这并未证明总体比率。在我们的预注册网格（0.80-0.98）中，没有任何语义阈值达到校准集90%的保守精确度目标。现有的裁判裁决策略在保留语料库上实现了98.1%的解决精确度和98.2%的候选帧召回率。在六个样本移除中，该策略没有确认的错误移除，但存在一个未解决的问题；这并未证明零风险。在评估的候选帧内，该策略比测试的语义阈值替代方案提供了更优的精确度-召回率平衡。召回率不能衡量候选帧外的污染。我们发布了审查后的标签、按策略的决策以及覆盖范围统计，以支持对清理可靠性和成本的评价，而不仅仅是重叠计数。

articles.title: KBS: A Korean Benchmark Suite for Foundation Model Evaluation
articles.abstract: We present a Korean Benchmark Suite (KBS) comprising Ko-ARC, Ko-GSM8K, Ko-EQ-Bench, Ko-WinoGrande, Ko-LAMBADA, and Ko-IFEval, covering six capabilities across 9,396 items. The suite combines review, localization, direct Korean construction, and redesign for Korean, avoiding a translation-only approach to benchmark adaptation. We evaluate Korean-developed models, multilingual open models, and closed API models under protocols that account for model access, prompt format, and scoring differences. Results show that Korean benchmark scores depend on task construction, scoring rules, prompting, and model post-training. These findings suggest that Korean evaluation should report both final scores and the settings used to obtain them.
articles.titleCn: KBS：用于基础模型评估的韩国基准套件
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了一套韩国基准测试套件（KBS），包括Ko-ARC、Ko-GSM8K、Ko-EQ-Bench、Ko-WinoGrande、Ko-LAMBADA和Ko-IFEval，涵盖六种能力，共9,396个项目。该套件结合了对韩国的评论、本地化、直接韩国构建和韩国重新设计，避免了基准测试适应中仅翻译的方法。我们在考虑模型访问、提示格式和评分差异的协议下，评估了韩国开发的模型、多语言开放模型和封闭API模型。结果表明，韩国基准测试分数取决于任务构建、评分规则、提示和模型后训练。这些发现表明，韩国评估应报告最终分数以及获得这些分数所使用的设置。

articles.title: Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally
articles.abstract: When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of \emph{some} (\emph{not all}) and \emph{or} (\emph{not both}) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the enriched reading and cancel it later. Answering from that early reading, an exploratory inference-time remedy, recovers these implicatures without losing literal accuracy. Evaluations of reasoning models should measure how they interpret, not only how accurate they are.
articles.titleCn: 娱乐，然后取消：思考如何使推理模型字面理解“一些或”
articles.abstractCn: 当说话者说“有些学生通过了考试”时，听众会推断并非所有学生都通过了。现在的推理模型允许用户决定模型思考多长时间再回答，但我们不知道额外的思考会对这类日常推理产生什么影响。我们直接研究了这个问题：我们保持模型的权重不变，只改变其思考的时间长度，并记录它选择了哪个解读。第二个工具是在模型的推理过程中依次切断推理，并要求给出答案，以显示解读的变化点。思考使模型将逻辑词汇视为逻辑：它取消大多数测试过的开放式推理模型和GPT-5中“有些”（并非所有）和“或”（并非两者都）的隐含义，而以情境驱动的推理（如间接回答）则有所改善。追踪记录显示了原因：模型首先考虑了丰富的解读，然后又取消了它。从那个早期的解读中回答，这种探索性的推理时间补救措施，在不丢失字面准确性的情况下恢复了这些隐含义。对推理模型的评估应该衡量它们如何解读，而不仅仅是它们的准确性。

articles.title: Who May Release an Agent's Promise? Standing over Commitments in Multi-Party Chat
articles.abstract: When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8-27B: 89%; gpt-6.1-sol: 83%); nearly all act on a bystander's "go ahead after all". Oracles dissociate the errors: stating the rule or the creditor curbs unauthorized release but not override, which the latter even raises in three of four models; among them, only knowing whether the promise is still owed cuts override. Enabling thinking moves smaller models the way scale does. A self-kept commitment ledger stops override in four of five models; with a one-paragraph release policy it matches or beats the best oracle store, raising gpt-6-luna's strict accuracy from 49% (policy alone) to 83%. Code, prompts, outputs and labels are released.
articles.titleCn: 谁可以发布代理的承诺？在多方聊天中维护承诺
articles.abstractCn: 当一个团队助理向爱丽丝做出承诺时，谁可以取消它？我们称之为“有资格”：只有债权人（被欠款方）或经债权人或操作员政策授权的人才能解除承诺，无论其职位高低。在受控的聊天环境中，我们改变谁可以取消，并区分两种错误：无权解除（服从无资格的人）和覆盖（执行已解除的承诺）。在六个模型中，较小的开放模型覆盖债权人（Qwen3.5-9B：69%）；较大的模型根据同级的直接说法放弃承诺（Qwen3.8-27B：89%；gpt-6.1-sol：83%）；几乎所有模型都根据旁观者的“最终同意”采取行动。预言者区分了这些错误：声明规则或债权人会抑制无权解除，但不会抑制覆盖，后者在四个模型中的三个中甚至提高了覆盖率；其中，只有知道承诺是否仍然被欠款才会抑制覆盖。启用思考使较小模型的性能提升与规模扩大相似。一个自我保留的承诺账本在五个模型中的四个中阻止了覆盖；通过一个段落长的解除政策，它匹配或超越了最佳预言者存储，将gpt-6-luna的严格准确率从49%（仅政策）提高到83%。代码、提示、输出和标签都被解除。

articles.title: Beyond Retrieval Failure: Understanding Why LLMs Miss Evidence in Multi-Hop RAG
articles.abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires an agent to retrieve evidence for a sequence of dependent sub-questions. When a wrong answer lacks a required passage, the passage may be inaccessible to the retriever, or the agent may have failed to issue a query that would retrieve it. Standard retrieval evaluations conflate these two causes. We study how much apparent retrieval failure is instead caused by search drift: the search no longer tracks an unanswered sub-question. Holding the retriever, corpus, and generation model fixed, we introduce ExecutionRAG, a training-free requirement register that records open sub-questions and their supporting evidence. The register changes search guidance but not evidence access, so each gold passage it recovers certifies that the passage was reachable by the original retriever. On 1,000 MuSiQue questions, the number of wrong answers with unretrieved required evidence falls from 382 to 234 with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and from 383 to 274 with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B. These counts correspond to 69% to 44% and 66% to 48% of each system's wrong answers, respectively. Crucially, evidence recovery does not produce a proportional reduction in total error: premature resolutions and abstentions increase as missing-evidence failures decrease. The central finding is therefore a shift in the remaining bottleneck, from guiding search toward required evidence to verifying that the retrieved evidence is sufficient.
articles.titleCn: 超越检索失败：理解大语言模型为何在多跳检索增强中错失证据
articles.abstractCn: 多跳检索增强生成（RAG）需要代理为一系列依赖的子问题检索证据。当错误答案缺乏所需段落时，该段落可能对检索器不可用，或者代理可能未能发出能够检索它的查询。标准检索评估将这两种原因混淆。我们研究了多少看似的检索失败实际上是搜索漂移造成的：搜索不再跟踪未回答的子问题。保持检索器、语料库和生成模型不变，我们引入了ExecutionRAG，这是一种无需训练的需求登记表，记录开放的子问题和它们的支持证据。该登记表改变搜索指导但不改变证据访问，因此它恢复的每个金段落都证明该段落可被原始检索器检索到。在1,000个MuSiQue问题上，使用all-MiniLM-L6-v2时，未检索到所需证据的错误答案数量从382减少到234，使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B时从383减少到274。这些数量分别对应于每个系统错误答案的69%到44%和66%到48%。关键在于，证据恢复并未导致总错误成比例减少：随着缺证据失败的减少，过早解决和拒绝回答增加。因此，核心发现是瓶颈的转移，从引导搜索到所需证据转变为验证检索到的证据是否足够。

articles.title: Judging the Judges: Confidence and Disagreement in Rubrics as Rewards
articles.abstract: Rubrics as Rewards (RaR) extends reinforcement learning to non-verifiable domains by using an LLM judge to score responses against a structured rubric. Prior work has focused on improving the rubric or strengthening the single judge, with comparatively little attention to how different single or multiple judges might be used during RaR training. We first show that judge identity alone produces a substantial spread in scores when training Qwen3-4B-Base on RaR-Medicine and RaR-Science across five frontier and open-weight judges. Building on this, we propose RaRE (Rubrics as Rewards with Ensembles), a novel judge ensemble strategy for RaR with two mechanisms: a soft-Likert reward that uses judge logprobs to weight more confident judges more heavily, and a drop-on-disagreement mask that excludes high-disagreement rollouts from the GRPO update. We find that this design is critical: while a naive average of judge scores fails to outperform the best single judge, RaRE outperforms every single-judge RaR variant on both HealthBench and GPQA Diamond, with per-theme analysis showing that it inherits the complementary strengths of its constituent judges. Our findings establish judge ensembling as a compelling axis for improving RaR.
articles.titleCn: 评判法官：评分标准中的自信与分歧作为奖励
articles.abstractCn: 评分标准作为奖励（RaR）通过使用大型语言模型（LLM）裁判根据结构化评分标准对响应进行评分，将强化学习扩展到不可验证领域。以往的研究主要集中在改进评分标准或加强单个裁判，而较少关注在RaR训练过程中如何使用不同的单个或多个裁判。我们首先表明，在RaR-Medicine和RaR-Science上训练Qwen3-4B-Base时，仅裁判身份就能在五个前沿和开放权重裁判之间产生显著的评分差异。在此基础上，我们提出了RaRE（评分标准作为奖励的集成），这是一种针对RaR的新型裁判集成策略，包含两个机制：一个软-李克特奖励，它使用裁判日志概率来更重地加权更自信的裁判；以及一个基于分歧的丢弃掩码，它从GRPO更新中排除高分歧的 rollout。我们发现这种设计至关重要：虽然裁判评分的简单平均值未能优于最佳单个裁判，但RaRE在HealthBench和GPQA Diamond上均优于所有单个裁判的RaR变体，每个主题的分析表明它继承了其组成裁判的互补优势。我们的研究结果表明，裁判集成是改进RaR的一个引人注目的方向。

articles.title: Language Models Share a Readout Bottleneck in Working Memory
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) reproduce a human working-memory signature on the N-back task: performance declines as memory load N increases, and errors concentrate on lures, items that repeat the current stimulus at a neighboring but incorrect serial position. We ask whether this shared behavioral signature reflects a shared mechanism. The literature offers two candidate accounts. On a precision account, softmax attention cannot concentrate its weight on the item N positions back, so adjacent items are retrieved instead. On an interference account, attention selects the correct item, but the content of competing items corrupts the decision. We dissociate these accounts in 15 pretrained LLMs from three families (70 million to 14 billion parameters) and in minimal transformers trained from scratch. In all three families, the attention heads that carry the task attend to the target on most missed matches. Linear probes decode near-perfectly whether a matching letter occurred at the target or at a lure position, even on trials where the model false-alarms to the lure, although its own decisions barely distinguish the two. Sharpening attention yields negligible gains, whereas suppressing the letter identity of non-target items improves sensitivity (d') in nearly all model-by-load conditions. In larger models the task is spread over more heads, and removing interference helps more. In minimal transformers, precision limits a single attention layer, but a second layer removes this constraint. The working-memory limit of LLMs therefore lies in reading items out under interference rather than in locating them, consistent with interference accounts of human working memory.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型在工作记忆中共享一个读取瓶颈
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在N-back任务中复现了人类工作记忆的典型特征：随着记忆负荷N的增加，表现会下降，且错误集中在对当前刺激重复但处于相邻但错误序列位置的诱饵项上。我们探究这种共享的行为特征是否反映了共享的机制。文献提出了两种候选解释。在精确性解释中，softmax注意力无法将权重集中在对N个位置前的项上，因此会检索相邻项。在干扰解释中，注意力选择正确项，但竞争项的内容会干扰决策。我们在来自三个系列（参数量从7000万到140亿不等）的15个预训练LLMs以及从头训练的最小Transformer模型中区分了这两种解释。在所有三个系列中，执行任务的注意力头大多关注在多数错配的目标上。线性探针能够近乎完美地解码匹配字母是否出现在目标位置或诱饵位置，即使在模型对诱饵产生误报的试验中也是如此，尽管其自身决策几乎无法区分这两个位置。增强注意力带来的收益微乎其微，而抑制非目标项的字母身份则几乎在所有模型-负荷条件下提高了敏感度（d'）。在更大的模型中，任务分布在更多注意力头上，消除干扰的效果更好。在最小Transformer模型中，精确性限制了单个注意力层，但第二层消除了这一限制。因此，LLM的工作记忆限制在于干扰下的项读取而非定位，这与人类工作记忆的干扰解释一致。

articles.title: From Long Context to Selective Memory:A Survey of Memory-Centric Compression for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. We distinguish compute-active memory, which directly participates in model computation, from compute-inactive memory, which lies outside the computation path but can be stored, retrieved, updated, or forgotten, and we characterize offloaded KV caches, persistent prefix caches, and precomputed KV states as intermediate states on the activation path. On this basis, we formulate writing, offloading, recall, retrieval-and-injection, materialization, eviction, consolidation, and forgetting as state transitions within an information lifecycle, and introduce a budgeted cost model that places these operations in a single cost account. The resulting framework unifies short-term context compression, long-term memory management, and the transitions between them, and shows that the central challenge is not merely reducing information volume but deciding which information should participate in costly inference, when, and in what form. We further summarize evaluation dimensions, benchmark gaps, and open challenges, and argue that future research should move from static, pointwise compression toward dynamic, governable, lifecycle-aware memory management.
articles.titleCn: 从长时序到选择性记忆：面向大型语言模型的以记忆为中心的压缩技术综述
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文能力已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）处理复杂任务的关键，但不断扩展上下文窗口并未消除推理时的计算、存储和信息选择压力。现有的关于提示压缩、KV缓存管理、高效服务、检索增强和代理内存的研究通常孤立讨论，导致存储与计算之间信息流动的理解不足。本调查将长上下文压缩重新定义为资源分配问题，用于管理推理时的内存。我们将直接参与模型计算的“计算活跃内存”与处于计算路径之外但可存储、检索、更新或遗忘的“计算非活跃内存”区分开来，并将卸载的KV缓存、持久前缀缓存和预计算的KV状态表征为激活路径上的中间状态。基于此，我们将写入、卸载、召回、检索与注入、显化、驱逐、整合和遗忘定义为信息生命周期内的状态转换，并引入预算成本模型将这些操作纳入单一成本账户。由此形成的框架统一了短期上下文压缩、长期内存管理及其转换，并表明核心挑战并非仅仅是减少信息量，而是决定哪些信息应参与昂贵的推理、何时以及以何种形式参与。我们进一步总结了评估维度、基准差距和开放挑战，并主张未来研究应从静态、点状的压缩转向动态、可控、生命周期感知的内存管理。

articles.title: Automatic Sentence Completion Using Bengali Audio Speech with a Transformer-Based Early Speech Recognition System
articles.abstract: Dementia severely impairs communication abilities and turns everyday conversations into challenging experiences. Individuals affected by dementia frequently struggle to express their thoughts or complete sentences, making it difficult for family members and caregivers to understand their needs. This study proposes a novel approach to assist dementia patients by developing an integrated system that detects signs of dementia through Bangla speech and text analysis and provides sentence auto-completion support during conversations. To achieve this, recorded voices from individuals with and without dementia were analysed, and key acoustic features were extracted to capture vocal patterns associated with cognitive decline. A transformer-based model was employed to transcribe voice signals into text for linguistic analysis. In the classification task, several Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models were evaluated using both acoustic and textual representations, and the LSTM model architectures demonstrated strong capabilities for modelling contextual patterns in speech and language data. For the sentence auto-completion task, a sequential learning model based on a Bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) network with an attention mechanism was developed to sequentially complete partially expressed Bangla sentences during conversation. This research bridges the gap in dementia analysis in an underrepresented language and implements a sentence auto-completion framework for cognitive disorders.
articles.titleCn: 基于Transformer的早期语音识别系统，使用孟加拉语音频语音实现自动句子补全
articles.abstractCn: 痴呆症严重损害沟通能力，将日常对话变成充满挑战的经历。受痴呆症影响的个体经常难以表达思想或完成句子，这使得家庭成员和护理人员难以理解他们的需求。本研究提出了一种通过孟加拉语语音和文本分析检测痴呆症迹象，并在对话中提供句子自动补全支持的新方法来协助痴呆症患者。为此，分析了患有和未患有痴呆症个体的录音，提取了关键声学特征以捕捉与认知衰退相关的发声模式。采用基于Transformer的模型将语音信号转录为文本进行语言分析。在分类任务中，使用声学和文本表示评估了多种机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）模型，LSTM模型架构在建模语音和语言数据中的上下文模式方面表现出强大的能力。对于句子自动补全任务，开发了一种基于双向LSTM（Bi-LSTM）网络和注意力机制的序列学习模型，在对话中顺序补全部分表达的孟加拉语句子。这项研究填补了在代表性不足的语言中进行痴呆症分析的空白，并实现了针对认知障碍的句子自动补全框架。

articles.title: Stop Training Against Soft Users: Mentalized Adversarial Self-Play for Proactive Dialogue
articles.abstract: Proactive dialogue agents must guide multi-turn interactions toward task goals while adapting to users whose intentions and attitudes evolve. Existing planners improve system side action selection through search, learned policies, or user aware planning, but are often trained and evaluated against fixed or overly compliant simulators; as a result, high simulated success can reflect soft user bias rather than robust dialogue ability. We introduce MASP, a Mentalized Adversarial Self Play framework that treats proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between a system and a rationally resisting user. MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self play updates for the system and user policies. This turns robustness to rational resistance into a training objective rather than only an evaluation condition. Across diverse proactive dialogue benchmarks, compared with the widely used SFT and Planner-only approaches, MASP substantially improves success rate (SR) and rationality constrained success (RCSR), reduces average turns (AT), and performs better against hard users who make the task goal more difficult to achieve.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 18 pages including references and appendices; 1 figure
articles.titleCn: 停止针对软性用户的训练：用于主动对话的心理化对抗自我博弈
articles.abstractCn: 主动对话代理必须在适应用户意图和态度演变的同时，引导多轮交互朝着任务目标前进。现有规划器通过搜索、学习策略或用户感知规划来改进系统侧动作选择，但通常在固定或过度配合的模拟器上进行训练和评估；因此，高模拟成功率可能反映的是软用户偏见，而非稳健的对话能力。我们引入MASP，一个心理化对抗自我博弈框架，将主动对话视为系统与理性抵抗用户之间的部分可观察博弈。MASP用基于BDI的潜在状态表示用户不断变化的心理状态，将奖励侧教师心理化与策略侧学生心理化分开，并交替进行系统和用户策略的自我博弈更新。这使得对理性抵抗的稳健性成为训练目标，而不仅仅是评估条件。在多种主动对话基准测试中，与广泛使用的SFT和仅规划器方法相比，MASP显著提高了成功率（SR）和理性约束成功率（RCSR），减少了平均轮次（AT），并且在面对使任务目标更难实现的困难用户时表现更佳。

articles.title: CARE-SD: Explainable Reasoning Architecture for Local SLM Self-Disclosure Analysis in Textual Data
articles.abstract: Cybersecurity interviews uncover critical security experiences, behaviors, and privacy concerns often not fully captured by conventional technical assessments. Consequently, identifying genuine self-disclosures is challenging because statements are context-dependent, categories overlap, and automated interpretations may introduce unsupported claims. Locally deployed Small Language Models (SLMs) protect sensitive participant data by keeping processing within controlled environments, but their limited reasoning capabilities make simple prompting insufficient for context-aware and factually reliable analysis. This study developed CARE-SD (Context-Adaptive Reasoning and Explanation for Self-Disclosure), a novel four-module architecture integrating context-adaptive processing, hierarchical disclosure reasoning, explanation-consistency verification, and cross-batch reconciliation. We evaluated three local SLMs, including Llama 1B, Qwen 1.5B, and Llama 3B, using 82 independently annotated cybersecurity interviews across five organizational sectors. Comparisons included conventional classifiers, three prompting strategies, larger 8B--32B models, and architectural ablations. Two independent reviewers assessed disclosure labels, factual claims, and explanation correctness. CARE-SD improved the accuracy and evidence reliability of SLMs, increasing Llama 3B Macro-F1 from 0.80 to 0.88 while reducing unsupported claims by 60\%. Remarkably, the 3B model matched the 20B reference model in category Macro-F1, demonstrating the effectiveness of the architecture without requiring a larger model.
