articles.titleCn: CARE-SD：用于文本数据中本地SLM自我披露分析的具解释性推理架构
articles.abstractCn: 网络安全面试能够揭示传统技术评估往往无法全面捕捉的关键安全经验、行为和隐私问题。因此，识别真实的自我披露具有挑战性，因为陈述依赖于上下文、类别存在重叠，且自动解释可能引入未经证实的断言。本地部署的小型语言模型（SLM）通过将处理保持在受控环境内来保护敏感参与者数据，但它们有限的推理能力使得简单的提示不足以进行上下文感知和事实可靠的分析。本研究开发了CARE-SD（上下文自适应推理与自我披露解释），这是一种新型四模块架构，集成了上下文自适应处理、层级披露推理、解释一致性验证和跨批次调和。我们使用跨越五个组织部门的82份独立标注的网络安全面试数据，评估了三种本地SLM，包括Llama 1B、Qwen 1.5B和Llama 3B。比较对象包括传统分类器、三种提示策略、更大的8B--32B模型以及架构消融实验。两位独立评审员评估了披露标签、事实断言和解释的正确性。CARE-SD提升了SLM的准确性和证据可靠性，将Llama 3B Macro-F1从0.80提升至0.88，同时将未经证实的断言减少了60%。值得注意的是，3B模型在类别Macro-F1上达到了20B参考模型的水平，证明了该架构在无需更大模型的情况下同样有效。

articles.title: From Observation to Intervention: Distilling Self-Generated In-Context Demonstrations via Executable Causal Intervention
articles.abstract: Self-generated In-Context Learning (ICL) enables LLMs to synthesize their own few-shot demonstrations, often outperforming manual prompts. However, existing methods filter demonstrations by observation, assuming a rationale is high-quality if it leads to the correct output. We show such filtering suffers from \textit{observational equivalence}, whereby both faithful causal rationales and spurious post-hoc rationales can yield same outputs and are statistically indistinguishable from observation alone. Inspired by independent causal mechanisms, we argue that faithful rationales imply \textit{transfer invariance}, in which causal rationales should remain effective across logically similar samples. We instantiate this criterion as \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{I}ntervention for \textbf{D}emonstrations \textbf{D}istillation (ECI2D), which abstracts language rationales into executable programs and applies the causal interventions ($do$-operator) on logically similar samples, retaining only those demonstrations that imply transfer invariance. Experiments on math, logical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ECI2D consistently outperforms observation-based ICL while retaining far fewer demonstrations, with gains exceeding 7 points as the test distribution shifts.
articles.titleCn: 从观察到干预：通过可执行的因果干预提炼自生成的情境演示
articles.abstractCn: 自生成情境学习（ICL）使大型语言模型能够合成自己的少量示例，通常优于手动提示。然而，现有方法通过观察来过滤示例，假设如果推理过程能得出正确结果，那么该推理就是高质量的。我们表明这种过滤方法存在“观察等价性”问题，即忠实的因果推理和虚假的后见之明推理都能产生相同的结果，并且与仅通过观察得出的结果在统计上无法区分。受独立因果机制的启发，我们认为忠实推理意味着“迁移不变性”，即因果推理应该在逻辑相似的样本中保持有效。我们将这一标准具体化为可执行因果推理示例蒸馏（ECI2D），该方法将语言推理抽象为可执行程序，并对逻辑相似的样本应用因果干预（$do$-算子），仅保留那些暗示迁移不变性的示例。在数学、逻辑和常识推理基准测试上的实验表明，ECI2D始终优于基于观察的ICL，同时保留的示例数量远少，随着测试分布的变化，性能提升超过7个百分点。

articles.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
articles.abstract: Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling. To address this limitation, we propose CoSTA, a compatibility-preserving post-hoc framework that decouples generation and synthesis token spaces while retaining the original speech tokenizer and decoder. CoSTA extends the generation token space with compressed representations via mean-initialized vocabulary extension, pronunciation adaptation, and dialogue adaptation, followed by deterministic expansion back to the original speech-token space before synthesis. On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately $1.7\times$ expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput while preserving response quality. Analyses show more sustained interaction under limited budgets and a practical trade-off among compression, decoding efficiency, and quality. Further experiments demonstrate cross-architecture transfer and complementarity to low-rate tokenization.
articles.titleCn: CoSTA：压缩语音标记自适应技术，用于高效语音对话模型
articles.abstractCn: 语音对话模型（SDMs）通常共享生成和合成用的语音标记空间，导致长自回归序列和昂贵的推理。低比特率语音标记器缩短了序列，但可能引入压缩质量权衡和昂贵的替换，且无法打破这种耦合。为解决此限制，我们提出了CoSTA，这是一个保持兼容性的后处理框架，它解耦了生成和合成标记空间，同时保留了原始语音标记器和解码器。CoSTA通过均值初始化词汇扩展、发音适应和对话适应，扩展生成标记空间以包含压缩表示，然后在合成前通过确定性扩展回到原始语音标记空间。在双语语音对话基准测试中，CoSTA实现了约1.7倍的语音标记生成速度提升，降低了全响应延迟，并提高了吞吐量，同时保持了响应质量。分析表明，在有限预算下实现了更持续的交互，并在压缩、解码效率和质量之间找到了实用权衡。进一步实验展示了跨架构迁移和与低比特率标记化的互补性。

articles.title: When Judges Agree and Are Wrong: Consistency-Accuracy Dissociation as a Blind Spot for Label-Free Evaluation
articles.abstract: Label-free evaluation methods, such as self-consistency filtering, majority-vote aggregation, and agreement-based reliability scoring, rely on an implicit assumption that consistency can serve as a proxy for correctness when ground-truth labels are unavailable or expensive to obtain. In this paper, we test this assumption directly. Using four financial QA datasets (multiple-choice and free-form), ten consistency dimensions, and two frontier model families, we measure the joint distribution of consistency and accuracy at the level of individual examples rather than in aggregate. We find that 60% of all incorrect answers fall in the high-consistency region (consistency $\geq$ 0.8), and that 77.7% of these show complete answer collapse, i.e. identical wrong answers across all perturbation variants. This high-consistency/incorrect quadrant cannot be detected by any evaluation signal that is built on agreement alone, as the model appears maximally reliable while being wrong. We show that the phenomenon is robust to the choice of consistency threshold t (it persists from t=0.50 to t=1.00), is shared across model families, and is concentrated in specific intersections of perturbation dimension and domain. We map where this quadrant occurs, analyze its stability properties, and discuss the implications for evaluation pipelines that use agreement-based signals in place of human labels.
articles.titleCn: 当法官们意见一致且错误：一致性-准确性分离作为无标签评估的盲点
articles.abstractCn: 无标签评估方法，如自洽性过滤、多数投票聚合和基于一致性的可靠性评分，依赖于一个隐含假设：当真实标签不可用或获取成本高昂时，一致性可以作为正确性的代理指标。本文直接检验这一假设。我们使用四个金融问答数据集（选择题和自由文本题）、十个一致性维度以及两个前沿模型家族，在单个样本层面而非整体层面测量一致性和准确性的联合分布。我们发现，所有错误答案中有60%落在高一致性区域（一致性$\geq$0.8），其中77.7%表现出完全答案崩溃，即所有扰动变体中给出相同的错误答案。这个高一致性/错误象限无法被任何仅基于一致性的评估信号检测到，因为模型在错误时表现出最大程度的可靠性。我们证明该现象对一致性阈值t的选择具有鲁棒性（它持续存在于t=0.50至t=1.00之间），在所有模型家族中普遍存在，并集中在特定的扰动维度和领域交叉点。我们绘制了该象限出现的区域，分析了其稳定性特性，并讨论了其对使用基于一致性的信号替代人类标签的评估流程的启示。

articles.title: Compression Does Not End at Selection: Post-Selection Positional Geometry for Sparse KV Caches
articles.abstract: Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. It reuses existing K/V without renewed selection, historical re-prefill, or additional cache budget. Across 36 comparisons spanning two models, six sparse selectors, and three long-term memory tasks, RoPERelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with BM25 on LongMemEval-S, accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. Measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations. These findings establish positional organization as a distinct optimization dimension for sparse KV caches after content selection.
articles.titleCn: 压缩并非止于选择：稀疏KV缓存的选后位置几何
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏KV压缩通过保留选定的历史状态来降低长上下文推理成本，但这些状态通常保留其完整历史中的坐标。在旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）下，被驱逐标记留下的空位继续影响查询-键匹配，可能限制保留证据的使用。我们研究了固定选择器生成的缓存上的后选择位置几何，考察了位置组织如何影响保留信息的使用，以及哪些坐标和延续规则能提升答案质量。为重新组织这种几何，我们提出了RoPERelay，它分配紧凑且保持顺序的RoPE坐标，通过逆旋转和再旋转重新定位缓存的键相位，并同步当前查询和后续生成。它无需重新选择、历史重新填充或额外缓存预算即可重用现有K/V。在涵盖两个模型、六个稀疏选择器和三个长期记忆任务的36次比较中，RoPERelay在32个案例中提升了答案质量。对于在LongMemEval-S上使用BM25的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，准确率从23.6%提升至35.4%。在评估配置中，完整请求时间开销约为1%-3%。这些发现确立了位置组织作为内容选择后稀疏KV缓存的一个独特优化维度。

articles.title: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
articles.abstract: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.
articles.titleCn: Kolab：长时程工作流中人类-智能体协作的基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 当人类与AI代理合作处理长期任务时，代理的贡献会发生什么变化？为了解决长期任务，人类更重视与AI代理的持续互动（例如，修订计划），而非代理单次尝试完成任务的能力。然而，大多数代理基准测试更侧重于自动化。在这些基准测试上的优异表现并不代表有效的现实世界协作。专业工作流程提供了一个有用的场景，因为它们通常涉及相互依赖的步骤。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Kolab，这是一个包含50位来自40个职业的专业人士与代理合作解决真实长期问题的115小时以上屏幕录制数据集。Kolab还包含参与者对协作和输出质量的判断。我们的分析揭示了多样的协作模式，突出了专业人士何时以及如何与代理协调的重要性。一个协作型代理必须做两件事，而自动化基准测试从未测试过：预测专家在离开聊天窗口后会采用、修改还是拒绝其贡献，以指导其下一步行动；以及在不依赖持续专家反馈的情况下，评估正在展开的工作流程中的协作质量。我们的基准测试实现了这两方面：(1) 预测专业人士在不同工作流程中如何使用代理的贡献，以及(2) 验证他们对协作满意度和输出质量的判断。研究结果表明，前沿模型（包括代理型和非代理型）都高估了与专家的协作，且难以区分高质量和低质量的协作。更长的工流程上下文并不能始终改善这些预测。由于前沿代理目前尚无法理解与专家的长期协作，我们将Kolab定位为一个基于真实专业工作流程研究人机协作的有价值数据集。

articles.title: Planning Commitment of LLM under Partial Observability
articles.abstract: LLM-based planning agents commit to plans of different lengths before interacting with a partially observable environment. Some aggressively commit to a long plan based on assumptions about unobserved states, while others conservatively plan only over what they have observed. Both behaviors emerge implicitly in pre-trained models, whether the LLM outputs a plan directly or generates a PDDL formulation for a classical solver. Aggressive commitment risks costly failures, while conservative commitment risks excessive LLM calls. This choice pits safety against efficiency, a trade-off that has been neither characterized systematically nor made controllable. We investigate aggressive and conservative LLM planners and formalizers on two partially observable domains, where priors are provided as either explicit statistics or common-sense knowledge. Across three LLMs, both strategies reach similar accuracy. Conservative methods achieve fewer failed attempts (safety) at the cost of more API calls (efficiency). Aggressive methods fail more often but replan efficiently only when priors are informative. Interestingly, analysis shows that LLMs treat the provided priors nearly as facts, which risks failure when priors are unreliable. We also explore hybrid strategies with tunable hyperparameters that adjust the balance between safety and efficiency.
articles.titleCn: 在部分可观察性下的大型语言模型的规划承诺
articles.abstractCn: 基于LLM的规划代理在与部分可观察环境交互之前会承诺不同长度的计划。有些代理会基于对未观察状态的假设而激进地承诺一个长计划，而另一些代理则保守地仅规划已观察到的内容。这两种行为都会在预训练模型中隐含地出现，无论LLM直接输出计划还是为经典求解器生成PDDL公式。激进承诺可能导致代价高昂的失败，而保守承诺则可能因过多的LLM调用而效率低下。这种选择在安全性与效率之间进行了权衡，而这一权衡既没有被系统地描述，也无法被控制。我们研究了在两个部分可观察领域中激进型和保守型LLM规划器和形式化器，其中先验知识以显式统计或常识知识的形式提供。在三种LLM中，两种策略都达到了相似的准确率。保守方法以更多API调用为代价（效率）实现了更少的失败尝试（安全）。激进方法更容易失败，但当先验知识具有信息量时，它们能够高效地重新规划。有趣的是，分析表明LLM几乎将提供的先验知识视为事实，这可能导致当先验知识不可靠时出现失败。我们还探索了具有可调超参数的混合策略，这些超参数调整了安全性与效率之间的平衡。

articles.title: ToolBottleneckBench: Measuring Tool-Agent Performance under Controlled Pressures and Fixed Harness Budgets
articles.abstract: The success score of a tool agent reflects both its model and the budgets of the harness that runs it. We present ToolBottleneckBench, a benchmark that measures tool-agent performance under controlled pressures and fixed harness budgets. Synthetic enterprise tasks stay fixed while one pressure varies: the registered tool catalog, the visible tool menu, the certified workflow, or the encoding of returned records. An exact grader records the first unmet obligation of each failed episode and the harness limit, if any, that ended it. Across 21 model and harness configurations, the visible menu is the only one of the three pressures that act on the model with a large penalty, and this penalty tracks truncation at the completion cap. Raising the cap sixteenfold removes most of the penalty in the truncation-heavy configurations. Most failures end at a harness limit, and the failure record identifies the assigned pressure no more reliably than a count of tool calls. The repairs that help change which tools reach the model or who issues the calls, and only two repairs, neither improving model behavior, beat every configuration switch. We recommend reporting pressure effects with the harness budgets under which they were measured. We release the benchmark at https://github.com/zichuanxu/tool-bottleneck-bench.
articles.titleCn: ToolBottleneckBench：在受控压力和固定套件预算下测量工具-代理性能
articles.abstractCn: 工具代理的成功评分反映了其模型以及运行它的容器的预算。我们提出了ToolBottleneckBench，这是一个在受控压力和固定容器预算下衡量工具代理性能的基准。合成企业任务保持固定，而一个压力变量会变化：注册的工具目录、可见的工具菜单、认证的工作流或返回记录的编码。精确评分器会记录每个失败场景中首次未满足的义务以及导致其结束的容器限制（如果有）。在21种模型和容器配置中，可见菜单是三个作用于模型的压力中唯一一个带有显著惩罚的，并且这种惩罚与完成上限的截断跟踪。将上限提高16倍消除了截断严重配置中的大部分惩罚。大多数失败发生在容器限制处，并且失败记录在识别分配的压力方面，其可靠性不亚于工具调用计数。那些有助于改变哪些工具能到达模型或谁发起调用，并且只有两种修复措施（均未改善模型行为）胜过了所有配置切换。我们建议在报告中附带测量压力效果时的容器预算。我们在https://github.com/zichuanxu/tool-bottleneck-bench上发布了该基准。

articles.title: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.
articles.titleCn: MemComposer：通过强化学习让大型语言模型代理学习组装记忆
articles.abstractCn: 代理记忆使大型语言模型（LLM）代理能够在不更新其参数的情况下重用过去的经验。然而，仅靠语义相似性并不能保证记忆的有效性：下游性能取决于如何选择和呈现记忆给代理。我们提出了MemComposer，一个联合检查当前查询和检索候选的记忆组合器，用于决定包含哪些经验、选择多少以及如何排序它们。我们使用经验策略优化（ExPO）训练该组合器，这是一个基于GRPO的框架，通过完整的代理交互评估组合的记忆上下文，并使用任务成功反馈来优化组合策略。在三个τ²-基准领域中，使用两个冻结的执行器，MemComposer在各自的执行器中均优于最强的基线，同时将平均记忆标记使用量分别降低了16.9%和4.9%。学习到的策略还可以迁移到未见过的领域、执行器和记忆库，并能从更强模型的记忆中受益而无需进一步训练。这些结果表明，使用下游任务反馈学习特定查询的记忆组合具有价值。

articles.title: A Jury, Not an Electorate: Label-Free Reliability Estimation for Ensembles of Language Models
articles.abstract: An ensemble of language models is a jury, not an electorate. The answers are testimony from witnesses of unknown reliability, and the question is not what the majority said but who is credible. Most ensemble methods assign each expert a fixed reputation, often learned from labels. We ask whether it can instead be inferred from the pattern of agreement and disagreement among the experts. We model the experts as a jury: each question has a latent true answer, each expert reports it with unknown reliability, and those reliabilities are estimated by Expectation Maximisation (EM) from unlabelled answer configurations alone. We show that its decision rule reduces to a log-odds weighted linear score over the experts' answer distributions. What changes is not how the jury votes, but how it learns whom to trust. On a 1560-question benchmark, the jury, with nine experts of up to 3B parameters, performs comparably to the same fusion rule with label-fitted weights, showing no statistically significant advantage from supervision. Instead, it outperforms the best single model with matched self-consistency and the strongest label-free alternative on the full benchmark.
articles.titleCn: 陪审团而非选民：无标签可靠性估计语言模型集成
articles.abstractCn: 一个语言模型集合是一个陪审团，而非选民。这些答案来自可靠性未知的证人证词，问题不在于多数人的意见是什么，而在于谁值得信赖。大多数集成方法为每个专家分配一个固定的声誉，通常从标签中学习。我们提出是否可以反过来从专家之间的一致和分歧模式中推断出这种声誉。我们将专家建模为陪审团：每个问题都有一个潜在的真实答案，每个专家以未知的可靠性报告它，而这些可靠性通过仅从无标签答案配置中用期望最大化（EM）方法进行估计。我们证明其决策规则简化为对专家答案分布的以对数优势加权的线性评分。变化的是陪审团如何投票，而不是它如何学习信任谁。在一个包含1560个问题的基准测试中，由九个最多拥有3B参数的专家组成的陪审团，其表现与使用标签拟合权重的相同融合规则相当，显示出没有统计上显著的监督优势。相反，它优于具有匹配自洽性和最强的无标签替代方案的最佳单个模型，在完整基准测试中表现最佳。

articles.title: Multimodal AI Detection for Math-Heavy Scientific Text
articles.abstract: As large language models become increasingly capable of generating, and assisting with, scientific writing, there is a need for greater transparency and disclosure around the use of AI in research. Consequently, a veritable subfield of research and a number of commercial services aim to flag AI-generated content automatically. However, existing detectors which rely only on text extracted from PDFs fail to benefit from the rich visual information contained in the formatting of math-heavy scientific content. To study this, we select human-written proof and prose passages from pre-2022 arXiv LaTeX sources and re-generate them using 15 modern LLMs within the context of the same paper. This leaves us with coupled human and AI outputs in three different representations: the LaTeX source, a rendered image of the PDF, and the text extracted from the PDF. We find that the accuracy of the state-of-the-art Pangram 4 drops significantly as the mathematical content in a passage increases, especially when evaluated on text as opposed to LaTeX. However, this is not an inherent limitation of detecting AI-generated math: finetuning Qwen-3.5-27B based detectors on this domain recovers the gap, with LaTeX inputs performing significantly better than text since they preserve more formatting information. Since LaTeX sources are rarely available in practice, we also train SnapJudge: an image-based detector operating on screenshots of both prose and proofs from papers. At 0.1% false positive rate, SnapJudge achieves a detection rate of 92% on proofs and 93% on prose generated by frontier models, substantially outperforming both Pangram 4 and our text-based detector. We release our data, models and code at https://nlplab.cs.duke.edu/snapjudge.
articles.titleCn: 多模态人工智能检测用于数学密集型科学文本
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型在生成和辅助科学写作方面的能力日益增强，围绕人工智能在研究中的使用需要更高的透明度和信息披露。因此，一个真正的子研究领域以及一些商业服务旨在自动标记人工智能生成的内容。然而，仅依赖于从PDF中提取文本的现有检测器无法利用数学密集型科学内容中包含的丰富视觉信息。为了研究这一点，我们从2022年以前的arXiv LaTeX源中选取人类编写的证明和散文段落，并在同一篇论文的背景下使用15个现代LLM重新生成它们。这留下了三种不同表示形式中的人类和人工智能耦合输出：LaTeX源代码、PDF渲染图像以及从PDF中提取的文本。我们发现，随着段落中数学内容的增加，最先进的Pangram 4的准确率显著下降，尤其是在使用文本而不是LaTeX进行评估时。然而，这并不是检测人工智能生成数学的固有局限性：在这一点上微调Qwen-3.5-27B检测器可以弥补差距，因为LaTeX输入由于保留了更多格式信息，表现明显优于文本。由于LaTeX源代码在实际中很少可用，我们还训练了SnapJudge：一个基于图像的检测器，它对论文中的散文和证明的截图进行操作。在0.1%的假阳性率下，SnapJudge在由前沿模型生成的证明和散文上实现了92%的检测率，在散文上实现了93%的检测率，显著优于Pangram 4和我们的基于文本的检测器。我们在https://nlplab.cs.duke.edu/snapjudge上发布了我们的数据、模型和代码。

articles.title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement, in which AI systems build stronger AI systems, is one promising route to superintelligence. We study a weaker form that can be measured today: frontier agents post-training a small raw base model with public data, as a test of their research potential. We build Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research (AutoPostTrain) on real GPUs. We give the agents full research autonomy, low-friction engineering tools, and efficient starter code. The agents carry out the research themselves: they read datasets and evaluation results, build their training data, write and modify training algorithms, tune hyperparameters, and analyze the results to decide what to try next. They work in a sandbox and cannot use external teacher models. Athanor's services supply frozen evaluation, managed jobs, decontaminated data, a persistent research record, and a held-out suite the agents are unaware of. In a 104-hour campaign, a team of four Claude Opus 5.5 agents, each on an eight-GPU node and given no research advice, improves Qwen3-4B-Base from 15.9 to 67.3 on a six-task development suite and from 9.2 to 48.2 on a held-out suite, against 66.5 and 47.9 for the official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a team of frontier agents can autonomously post-train a raw base model into a cross-domain generalist model that matches or surpasses the official instruct version on average. The campaign's full record shows that the agents reach this level by recombining known methods and each other's models: SFT on public reasoning data, RL with a rollout change one agent introduced, weight merges across agents, and rounds of self-distillation. With execution handled, today's agents already have the engineering and research ability to conquer this task. We hope Athanor provides a foundation for scaling autonomous AI research.
articles.titleCn: 阿塔诺尔：一种用于自主后训练研究的代理原生系统
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进，即AI系统构建更强大的AI系统，是实现超级智能的一条有前景的途径。我们研究一种较弱的形式，该形式可以今天就被测量：前沿代理在训练后使用公共数据对一个小型原始基础模型进行后训练，以此测试其研究潜力。我们构建了Athanor，一个基于真实GPU的开源代理原生系统，用于自主后训练研究（AutoPostTrain）。我们赋予代理完全的研究自主权、低摩擦工程工具和高效的启动代码。代理自己进行研究：它们读取数据集和评估结果，构建自己的训练数据，编写和修改训练算法，调整超参数，并分析结果以决定下一步尝试什么。它们在一个沙盒中工作，并且不能使用外部教师模型。Athanor的服务提供冻结评估、管理任务、净化数据、持久研究记录以及代理未知的保留套件。在一个104小时的活动中，一个由四个Claude Opus 5.5代理组成的团队，每个代理在八GPU节点上运行且未获得任何研究建议，将Qwen3-4B-Base在六任务开发套件上的得分从15.9提高到67.3，在保留套件上的得分从9.2提高到48.2，而官方Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507的得分分别为66.5和47.9。据我们所知，这是首次证明一个前沿代理团队可以自主后训练一个原始基础模型，使其成为一个跨领域通才模型，平均性能与官方指令版本相当或超越。活动的完整记录显示，代理通过重组已知方法和彼此的模型达到了这一水平：在公共推理数据上进行SFT、使用一个代理引入的 rollout 变化的强化学习、代理间的权重合并以及多轮自我蒸馏。随着执行的完成，今天的代理已经具备工程和研究能力来攻克这项任务。我们希望Athanor能为自主AI研究提供规模化基础。

articles.title: SHIP: Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy
articles.abstract: Extracting insights from textual data while protecting user privacy is increasingly important. Existing methods produce private insights in diverse forms for different analytical purposes, making their utility difficult to assess and compare. In this work, we formulate differentially private (DP) insights as reusable representations for answering analytical queries, providing a common basis for utility assessment. Answering these queries, however, requires fine-grained details and cross-attribute statistics that existing representations may omit. To capture this information, we introduce Structured and Hierarchical Insight with Privacy (SHIP), which automatically maps queries to attributes, builds a hierarchical hybrid taxonomy, and releases a DP synthetic table for further analysis. We also develop an evaluation protocol based primarily on QA performance and structured fidelity. Our experiments demonstrate SHIP's strong performance on both measures relative to existing private insight baselines, while identifying queries that remain challenging for structured representations.
articles.comment: This paper mainly work on extracting and evaluating insights from textual data
articles.titleCn: SHIP：结构化与分层洞察隐私保护
articles.abstractCn: 从文本数据中提取洞察力同时保护用户隐私正变得越来越重要。现有方法针对不同的分析目的生成多种形式的隐私保护洞察力，使得其效用难以评估和比较。在本工作中，我们将差分隐私（DP）洞察力定义为可重用的表示形式，用于回答分析查询，从而为效用评估提供一个共同的基础。然而，回答这些查询需要细粒度的细节和跨属性统计数据，而现有的表示形式可能遗漏这些信息。为了捕捉这些信息，我们引入了具有隐私的结构化分层洞察力（SHIP），它自动将查询映射到属性，构建一个分层混合分类体系，并发布一个DP合成表以供进一步分析。我们还开发了一个主要基于问答性能和结构化保真度的评估协议。我们的实验表明，与现有的隐私洞察力基线相比，SHIP在这两个指标上均表现出优异的性能，同时识别出对结构化表示仍然具有挑战性的查询。

articles.title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
articles.abstract: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. We introduce ReviewFact, a benchmark that labels such factual errors in review comments under one definition across NLP, machine learning, and the natural sciences, and that measures cost and latency alongside accuracy. A frontier LLM checks comments well but must read the whole paper for each check, while cheap decision models, which score whether a statement holds in a text, fall far short on whole comments that mix several implicit assertions. PremiseCheck is a framework that combines the two. An LLM rewrites each comment as explicit premises without reading the paper, and a decision model checks each premise against the paper. When each comment is checked on its own, PremiseCheck reaches accuracy comparable to GPT-5.5 across all three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of its cost and less than half its latency.
articles.titleCn: 前提检查：高效的人类与人工智能同行评审事实核查
articles.abstractCn: 同行评审因提交量激增而面临压力，由人类或人工智能撰写的评审意见可能会歪曲论文内容。我们介绍了ReviewFact，这是一个基准，它在一个定义下标记NLP、机器学习和自然科学领域中评审意见中的事实性错误，并衡量成本、延迟以及准确性。前沿的大型语言模型（LLM）能够很好地检查评论，但必须为每次检查阅读整篇论文，而廉价的决策模型，虽然能评分判断陈述是否在文本中成立，但在处理混合多个隐含断言的整段评论时却远远不足。PremiseCheck是一个结合两者的框架。LLM在不阅读论文的情况下将每条评论改写成明确的预设，而决策模型则将每个预设与论文进行核对。当独立检查每条评论时，PremiseCheck在三个领域中达到了与GPT-5.5相当的平均准确性，成本约为其一半，在NLP评审中成本仅为其四分之一，延迟不到其一半。

articles.title: ReviewPilot: A Multi-Agent System for Screening and Data Extraction in Systematic Reviews
articles.abstract: Systematic literature reviews follow the PRISMA process of screening scholarly works and extracting evidence from included studies. Deep research tools based on large language models (LLMs) can search and summarize the literature but do not record which studies are excluded or where extracted values come from. We develop a conversational multi-agent system called ReviewPilot that automates the PRISMA workflow from paper screening to information extraction. Researchers can tailor criteria and schemas through dialogue, and a project memory keeps their configurations and revisions. Each screening decision comes with its reason and each extracted value with its source. On epidemiological expert reviews, ReviewPilot outperforms a single-prompt LLM and AgentSLR across three LLMs, with screening macro F1 up to 0.776 and extraction F1 up to 0.788. Case studies in biomedicine and human-computer interaction show close agreement with human annotators, suggesting that ReviewPilot can transfer beyond epidemiology. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot.
articles.titleCn: ReviewPilot：用于系统评价筛选和数据提取的多智能体系统
articles.abstractCn: 系统综述遵循PRISMA流程筛选学术作品并从纳入的研究中提取证据。基于大型语言模型（LLM）的深度研究工具可以搜索和总结文献，但不会记录排除哪些研究或提取值来自何处。我们开发了一个对话式多智能体系统，名为ReviewPilot，该系统自动化了从论文筛选到信息提取的PRISMA工作流程。研究人员可以通过对话定制标准和模式，项目记忆则保存他们的配置和修订。每次筛选决策都附带其理由，每次提取值都附带其来源。在流行病学专家综述中，ReviewPilot在三个LLM的单一提示LLM和AgentSLR中表现更优，筛选宏观F1高达0.776，提取F1高达0.788。生物医学和人与计算机交互中的案例研究表明，与人工标注者高度一致，表明ReviewPilot可以超越流行病学领域。代码可在https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/ReviewPilot获取。

articles.title: INCONVENIENT: A Benchmark to Assess LLM Generalization Capabilities from Convenience Samples
articles.abstract: Machine learning models for tabular prediction typically assume that training data are representative of the population on which they will be deployed. In practice, however, data are often collected based on convenience, availability, or cost, resulting in systematic sampling biases that can distort feature--target relationships and undermine real-world generalization. Existing tabular distribution-shift benchmarks primarily construct out-of-distribution (OOD) settings by partitioning observations across naturally occurring domains. While such partitions may induce changes in P(Y | X), the resulting shifts are neither explicitly controlled nor isolated, and the evaluation distributions themselves are often not representative of the broader target population. We introduce INCONVENIENT, a benchmark designed to study robustness to convenience-sample bias. Rather than relying on naturally occurring domain partitions, INCONVENIENT directly perturbs feature--target relationships in the training distribution while preserving the original population distribution as the deployment environment. This setting more closely reflects real-world scenarios in which models are developed from unrepresentative samples and subsequently deployed on a broader population. The distinction is particularly relevant for large language models (LLMs), whose pretraining may encode population-level knowledge that extends beyond the relationships observed in a biased training dataset. Unlike existing distribution-shift benchmarks, INCONVENIENT provides explicit control over both the direction and severity of relationship shifts, enabling a systematic assessment of robustness to convenience sampling. The benchmark comprises 200 tabular classification and regression datasets spanning diverse application domains and generates around 15,500 shifted training distributions which lead to substantial downstream degradation.
articles.titleCn: 不便：一个基于便利样本评估大型语言模型泛化能力的基准
articles.abstractCn: 用于表格预测的机器学习模型通常假设训练数据能够代表其部署目标人群。然而在实践中，数据往往基于便利性、可用性或成本进行收集，导致系统性抽样偏差，这可能扭曲特征-目标关系并削弱实际泛化能力。现有的表格分布偏移基准主要通过与自然存在的领域划分来构建分布外（OOD）场景。尽管这种划分可能改变P(Y|X)，但由此产生的偏移既未被明确控制也未得到隔离，且评估分布本身往往不能代表更广泛的目标人群。我们引入INCONVENIENT基准，旨在研究对便利性抽样偏差的鲁棒性。该基准不依赖于自然存在的领域划分，而是直接扰动训练分布中的特征-目标关系，同时保留原始人群分布作为部署环境。这种设置更贴近现实场景：模型从非代表性样本中开发，随后部署到更广泛的人群中。这一区别对于大型语言模型（LLM）尤其重要，因为其预训练可能编码了超越有偏训练数据集中观察到的关系的人群级知识。与现有的分布偏移基准不同，INCONVENIENT能够明确控制关系偏移的方向和严重程度，从而实现对便利性抽样鲁棒性的系统性评估。该基准包含200个跨不同应用领域的表格分类和回归数据集，并生成了约15,500个偏移训练分布，导致下游任务性能显著下降。

articles.title: Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval
articles.abstract: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.
articles.titleCn: 学会何时思考：基于效用引导的自适应推理，以实现高效的文本检索
articles.abstractCn: 推理条件嵌入可以通过逐步细化语义约束来提升检索效果。然而，额外的推理可能引入过度泛化或语义噪声的抽象，从而削弱检索的精确性。现有方法主要通过最终检索结果来监督推理过程，对细化过程本身的指导有限。我们提出了AURA框架，该框架根据中间推理状态将相关文档与困难干扰项分离的效果直接监督推理状态。AURA进一步在前缀条件嵌入上训练一个轻量级效用估计器，以在推理时调整推理深度。在推理密集型BRIGHT基准测试中，AURA-4B实现了34.7的平均nDCG@10，同时每个查询使用2.8个推理步骤和96个生成的token。在匹配部署条件下，自适应停止将相对于完整轨迹推理的延迟从4.6秒减少到0.76秒。MS MARCO上的结果进一步表明，这种专业化并不需要显著降低传统领域内检索的性能。
